title: Business Systems Developer
jd_text: Purpose of Position As an Oracle Fusion / OIC Developer, you will design, develop, deploy, and support Oracle Integration Cloud integrations, technical extensions, and enterprise reporting solutions, combining hands-on development with technical leadership across on-prem, SaaS and PaaS applications and establishing continuous delivery and integration. Location and Work Environment India-Remote based on project requirements. Indoor work or home-office environment with good ventilation, adequate lighting, and low noise. Essential Functions Integration Development Design, develop, test, deploy, and support integrations using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC). Build inbound, outbound, real-time, scheduled, batch, event-driven, and API-based integrations between Oracle Fusion Cloud and third-party / external applications . Utilize Oracle Fusion REST APIs, SOAP services , PVOs, FBDI, UCM, ESS Jobs, OIC adapters, and event-driven architectures. Design reusable, scalable integration frameworks following Oracle best practices and enterprise integration patterns, with API governance. Load data conversions through the FBDI process and write specifications for conversions, integrations, modifications, and reports. Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, error handling, and autorecovery frameworks; optimize performance, scalability, and security. Technical Extensions and Platform Develop Oracle Fusion technical extensions using Oracle PaaS services , OCI , Oracle Visual Builder (VBCS) , and Oracle Autonomous Database (ATP). Administer and support different Oracle Cloud environments. Reporting and Data Design and maintain Fusion reports using BI Publisher (incl. report bursting), OTBI, BICC, Oracle Fusion Analytics, and SQL. Develop BIP data models using PVOs and SQL; create XML templates; build dashboards, KPIs, operational reports, scheduling/distribution. Create and optimize SQL and PL/SQL against PVOs/VOs; ensure data accuracy and optimize report/query performance. Security and Compliance Build secure integrations and APIs using OAuth 2.0, JWT, and API Gateway. Collaborate with the Information Security Architect and IT Compliance team on data privacy and security for cloud environments. Support, Testing and Leadership Provide L1/L2/L3 support; troubleshoot failures and coordinate resolutions with Oracle Support. Support Oracle quarterly updates by analyzing impacts, testing changes, and implementing enhancements. Develop unit test scripts and coordinate SIT/UAT with users and business analysts. Support production deployments, hypercare, and ongoing production support. Lead technical design sessions, perform code reviews, estimate effort, and mentor junior developers. Collaborate with DevOps teams on Git-based source control and CI/CD processes. Produce technical design, deployment guides, and operational documentation. Education, Background and Skill Requirements Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related technical field. 5+ years supporting Oracle Fusion integrations/reports; 5+ years hands-on OIC; 5+ years Oracle ERP/Fusion technical development preferred. Experience delivering Oracle Fusion Cloud implementation or upgrade projects across multiple enterprise projects. Strong analytical, troubleshooting, problem-solving, and performance-tuning skills. Excellent verbal and written communication; collaborative across functional borders. SDLC, requirement elicitation, documentation, test scripts; data management; Knowledge of Fusion Cloud modules. Certifications Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) Certification - Preferred. Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) Certification - Preferred; other Fusion certifications preferred. Nice-to-Have Skills VB Studio, OAC, Fusion Data Intelligence (FDI), Oracle Process Automation, Integration Insight, Python, event-driven/microservices, Oracle SOA Suite. title: Product Owner
jd_text: BSN SPORTS, A VARSITY BRANDS COMPANY - THE RECOGNIZED LEADER IN TEAM ATHLETIC GEAR For over 50 years, BSN SPORTS has been the largest team sporting goods equipment and apparel distributor of choice in the United States . Our 3,000 BSN SPORTS employees strive to support the Heart of the Game by putting valuable time back into the day of coaches and administrators through excellent service platforms. Our company mission is simple: Save coaches and administrators time with everything they do off the field so they have more time to impact young lives on it. LOCATION: Onsite 4 days per week at Farmers Branch TX Varsity Brands HQ HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT: The Product Owner supports and progressively expands ownership of the overall digital experience, product needs, and continuous-improvement priorities for one of BSN SPORTS' primary business channels: Club, Collegiate, or Institutional. This role serves as a primary product representative for the assigned channel, partnering with business stakeholders, executive leadership, Commercial teams, customers, frontline employees, and application-aligned Portfolio Product Owners. The position will identify opportunities, evaluate customer and business needs, contribute to prioritization decisions, and translate channel objectives into coordinated product initiatives across BSN SPORTS' digital platforms. Portfolio Product Owners are aligned to applications and platforms including BSNSports.com, My Team Shop, Sideline Stores, and Team Art Locker. The Product Owner will partner with the appropriate Portfolio Product Owners and senior Product Owners to ensure channel needs are understood, prioritized, and delivered through the relevant application roadmaps. Unresolved conflicts will be elevated to the executive steering committee for final direction. This role develops a strong understanding of how customer value, business priorities, and technical feasibility influence product decisions across the assigned channel. The Product Owner will support and contribute to product initiatives from discovery through launch and adoption. They will remain actively engaged in discovery, requirements, prioritization, testing, release readiness, and post-launch adoption, while maintaining lighter involvement during active software development and continuing to build expertise in product ownership, Agile delivery practices, customer discovery, and data-informed decision making. In addition to major initiatives, the role will maintain and prioritize a continuous backlog of smaller enhancements, customer pain points, defects, technical improvements, and operational-efficiency opportunities while developing the judgment and product management skills needed to independently own increasingly complex products and initiatives over time. Commercial teams retain accountability for revenue and business results. The Product Owner focuses on customer experience, product outcomes, adoption, usability, operational effectiveness, and translating channel needs into technology-enabled solutions. Working under the guidance of more senior Product Owners, this role develops the knowledge, judgment, and product management capabilities necessary to progressively assume greater ownership of product strategy, prioritization, customer outcomes, and product performance. title: Financial Business Intelligence Manager
jd_text: When you’re the best, we’re the best. We instill an environment where employees feel engaged, satisfied and able to contribute their unique skills and talents while living and working as their authentic selves . We provide extensive opportunities for personal and professional development, building both employee competence and organizational capability to fuel exceptional performance through an inclusive environment both now and in the future. Summary: In this role, you will lead the design and development of advanced finance analytics, business intelligence, and reporting solutions that support corporate targets and informed decision-making. You will independently build complex Power BI dashboards and data visualizations from the ground up, source and model data from Databricks and other data sources, and translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insights. This role sits at the intersection of Finance, Data Analytics, and Business Intelligence. The ideal candidate brings strong financial acumen together with hands-on technical expertise in Power BI development, data modeling, visualization design, and analytics solution delivery. Your work will support senior executives, the Finance Committee, the Board of Directors, investors, and internal business partners. Responsibilities: Independently design, build, test, deploy, and maintain complex Power BI dashboards, reports, and data visualization solutions from the ground up. Develop scalable Power BI solutions using advanced features such as data models, calculated measures, interactive slicers, drill-through functionality, and row-level security. Source, transform, model, and validate data from Databricks and other enterprise data sources to support finance reporting and analytics needs. Translate complex financial and operational data into intuitive visualizations, management insights, and executive-level financial narratives. Partner with Finance leaders and business stakeholders to gather requirements, define key performance indicators, and convert business needs into effective analytics solutions. Produce monthly and quarterly consolidated reporting and dashboards for senior executives, the Finance Committee, the Board of Directors, investors, and internal partners. Perform data reconciliation, validation, and quality assurance to ensure the accuracy and integrity of dashboards, reports, calculations, and underlying data. Collaborate with Accounting, Financial Systems, and technical partners to identify, troubleshoot, and resolve source-data, logic, integration, and reporting issues. Support FP&A team members with business-unit reporting, financial analysis, budgeting, forecasting, and performance insights. Identify opportunities to automate manual reporting, improve dashboard performance, streamline analytics processes, and strengthen self-service reporting capabilities. Qualifications: Relevant degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Business Administration, Economics, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field preferred. Advanced degree desired. Five or more years of experience in finance analytics, financial business intelligence, FP&A reporting, data visualization, or a related area. Demonstrated experience independently designing and building complex Power BI dashboards and reporting solutions from initial requirements through deployment and ongoing maintenance. Advanced hands-on Power BI development experience, including data modeling, DAX calculations, interactive visualizations, slicers, drill-through functionality, and row-level security. Experience sourcing, transforming, validating, and modeling data from Databricks or a comparable cloud-based enterprise data platform. Strong understanding of financial reporting, FP&A processes, financial statements, budgeting, forecasting, key performance indicators, and business-performance analysis. Experience translating financial and business requirements into scalable analytics, reporting, and visualization solutions. Ability to analyze complex data, recognize trends and anomalies, and communicate clear, actionable recommendations to business and executive audiences. Experience troubleshooting data-quality, reporting-logic, calculation, and source-system issues in partnership with finance and technical teams. Strong attention to detail with a demonstrated commitment to data accuracy, integrity, documentation, and quality assurance. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present complex financial and technical information to senior-level stakeholders. Willingness to travel. #LI - AC1 Estimated Hiring Range: At Vizient, we consider skills, experience, and organizational needs in our compensation approach. Geographic factors may adjust the range estimate and hires typically fall below the top range. Compensation decisions are tailored to individual circumstances. The current salary range for this role is $88,900.00 to $155,500.00. This position is also incentive eligible. Vizient has a comprehensive benefits plan! title: FP&A Financial Analyst III- (B3)
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $92,000.00 - $126,500.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . Role Summary The Financial Analyst, FP&A supports close, actuals, and planning activities for Worldwide Operations, with a focus on Manufacturing, Logistics, and Supply Chain. The role partners across the Finance organization and with WMO Operations and SPG Finance. It turns operational and financial data into clear, actionable insights. The analyst works with stakeholders at all levels, from frontline operations teams to senior Finance and executive leadership. They own key recurring deliverables and help improve how the organization reports and analyzes performance. Key Responsibilities Close, Consolidation & Actuals Own the WMO consolidation for total Cost of Sales (COS), including absorption, allocations, and related reconciliations, so results are accurate and on time each period. Run monthly and quarterly close activities on recurring tasks with minimal oversight, investigating and resolving variances and data issues as they come up. Analyze actuals against plan, forecast, and prior periods, identifying the operational drivers behind cost and absorption movements. Planning & Forecasting Support the annual operating plan (AOP/Pre-AOP) and quarterly forecast cycles for Manufacturing, Logistics, and Supply Chain, including spend, labor, capital, and volume-driven assumptions. Track and quantify P&L opportunities and risks (e.g., timing shifts, tariffs, reserve releases, completion risk), keeping leadership informed of the outlook and changes to it. Partner with Operations and SPG Finance to validate assumptions and keep forecasts consistent with business and fab/customer timing. Reporting & Executive Communication Prepare quarterly financial reporting packages for senior Finance and executive leadership, including clear actuals-vs-plan variance commentary. Build dashboards and executive-ready presentations that explain complex financial information clearly and concisely. Present findings to stakeholders across Finance and Operations, at times acting as a direct business partner to non-finance management. Process Improvement & Systems Lead efforts to streamline management reporting and to centralize data, reporting, and analytics into a reliable single source of truth. Serve as a key participant, or lead, on system integration and process improvement initiatives, improving efficiency, controls, and reporting capability. Identify chances to automate recurring work and to strengthen analytical tools. Qualifications Required Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field. 3–5 years of progressive experience in FP&A, cost accounting, or operations finance, preferably in a manufacturing or semiconductor environment. Solid understanding of cost of sales, inventory, absorption, and allocation methods, and how they flow through the P&L. Hands-on experience with month-end close, forecasting, and annual planning cycles. Advanced Excel skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, and building financial models. Experience with ERP systems (SAP preferred) and with pulling and reconciling data from multiple sources. Strong PowerPoint skills and the ability to turn complex data into clear, executive-ready storylines. Excellent written and verbal communication, including explaining variances and financial results to non-finance stakeholders. title: Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations, Global
jd_text: About Vantage Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. About Vantage Data Centers Vantage Data Centers powers, cools, protects, and connects the technology of the world's well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across 19 markets in North America, EMEA and APAC, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Vantage's business is growing exponentially, through a combination of greenfield market expansion and acquisitions. Business Optimization & Vendor Management Department The Business Optimization & Vendor Management team supports effective planning, financial visibility, operational discipline, and informed decision-making. The team partners with budget owners, business leaders, Finance, Procurement, and other stakeholders to maintain reliable planning information, monitor financial commitments, improve reporting, and strengthen processes that help the organization use its resources effectively. Position Overview The Business Analyst, Budget Planning & Financial Operations supports budgeting, forecasting, reporting, and analysis activities that help business leaders effectively manage approved budgets and financial commitments throughout the year. This role partners with budget owners and business leaders to maintain accurate forecasts, monitor spending, identify risks and opportunities, and keep assumptions aligned with current business needs. The analyst helps stakeholders avoid unexpected overspend while also identifying available funding and planned activities that may need action so approved resources are used effectively. The ideal candidate is analytical, highly organized, and comfortable working directly with stakeholders. As the individual develops knowledge of the business and its planning processes, they will take an increasingly active role in recurring forecast discussions, budget reviews, and follow-up with assigned budget owners. Essential Job Functions Budget Planning & Forecast Management Support annual budget planning and recurring forecast cycles, including non-labor operating expense and capital expenditure planning. Maintain and update forecast workbooks, planning files, assumptions, and supporting documentation throughout the year. Work with budget owners to understand spending plans, project timing, contract obligations, purchase commitments, and changing business priorities. Help budget owners maintain realistic forecasts that reduce the risk of overspending and highlight opportunities to use approved funding before year-end. Track forecast changes, open actions, and decisions to ensure planning information remains current and explainable. Identify potential overages, unused funding, timing shifts, and other risks or opportunities, and raise them for timely discussion and action. Support capital planning, project cost tracking, and workforce or position planning activities as assigned. Budget Owner & Business Leader Partnership Build productive working relationships with budget owners and business leaders. Prepare for and participate in recurring budget and forecast review meetings. Ask thoughtful questions, clarify assumptions, document decisions, and follow up on required updates. Explain budget, forecast, actual, and committed-spend information in clear business terms. Provide budget owners with timely information that supports prioritization and spending decisions. With appropriate training and experience, independently lead routine forecast conversations and serve as a primary point of contact for assigned budget owners. Coordinate with Finance and other stakeholders to resolve discrepancies and keep planning data aligned. Financial Analysis & Reporting Analyze budget, forecast, actual, committed, and planned spend information. Perform variance analysis and identify the operational drivers behind changes in financial performance. Review spending trends and summarize relevant risks, opportunities, and recommended follow-up actions. Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and concise leadership summaries. Support ad hoc analysis, project financial reviews, business cases, and return-on-investment analysis as needed. Contribute to budget planning scenarios and longer-range analysis using documented assumptions. Data Management, Controls & Process Improvement Reconcile financial and operational information across systems, reports, and source files. Our products support high-volume transaction processing and mission-critical capabilities used by financial institutions, merchants, fintechs, and payment ecosystem partners worldwide. We are seeking an experienced Lead Technical Program Manager to drive execution of large-scale, cross-functional portfolios spanning Product, Engineering, Data Science, Security, Operations, and Business teams. Lead large-scale software development programs following Agentic Squad Model, and modern SDLC practices from initiation to deployment. Manage dependencies, risks, impediments, and critical-path activities across multiple teams and organizations. Collaborate with engineering leadership to improve delivery predictability, system reliability, security, compliance, availability, resiliency, and operational excellence. Ensure compliance with organizational governance, security, audit, and regulatory requirements. Drive adoption of AI-enabled software delivery practices across engineering and product teams. Leverage GenAI and Agentic AI tools to improve program planning, requirements management, execution tracking, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management. Use AI-powered portfolio, project management, and engineering intelligence platforms to improve delivery predictability and resource optimization. Identify opportunities to automate program processes, reporting, governance workflows, backlog management, and operational tasks using AI solutions. Manage portfolio budgets, forecasts, and investment tracking. Provide executive visibility into portfolio health, resource utilization, risks, and business outcomes. Coach program managers, product, and delivery teams and promote a culture of accountability, transparency, continuous improvement, and execution excellence. Strong program and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives, competing priorities, and complex stakeholder relationships. title: Manager, IT Project Management
jd_text: Are you someone who strives for excellence, values accountability, provides the best service, all while reflecting unwavering integrity? Our talented team members across the state follow the behaviors, beliefs and outcomes of these core values to ensure that our vision is met. If you're ready to join the TSTC family and make great memories please complete our application process. Job Description The Manager of IT Project Management provides leadership, strategic direction, and operational oversight for the planning, execution, governance, and delivery of technology projects across Texas State Technical College. This position leads the IT Project Management team and is responsible for establishing consistent project management practices, strengthening institutional accountability, improving portfolio visibility, and ensuring technology initiatives align directly with College priorities. Reporting to the Director of IT Operational Services, the Manager collaborates closely with IT leadership, technical teams, business stakeholders, and external partners to manage scope, resources, schedules, dependencies, risks, and organizational change. The Manager fosters a culture of delivery excellence by balancing structured governance with agile, scalable practices adapted to project size and complexity. Essential Functions The employee will demonstrate TSTC’s Core Values of Excellence, Accountability, Service, and Integrity with internal and external stakeholders, customers, students, and community members. Team Leadership & Capability Development Provides direct leadership, mentorship, and operational supervision to the IT Project Management team by setting clear performance expectations, conducting regular evaluations, and fostering ongoing professional development. Fosters a collaborative and accountable team culture that emphasizes customer service, continuous capability growth, and disciplined project execution across all technology initiatives. Project Portfolio Governance & Reporting Establishes, implements, and continuously refines institutional IT project management standards, methodologies, templates, and performance metrics across predictive, Agile, and hybrid delivery frameworks. Monitors overall portfolio health, resource capacity, and schedule milestones while delivering transparent, data-driven reporting and actionable recommendations to executive and IT leadership. Project Execution & Technical Integration Oversees the end-to-end execution of complex, cross-functional technology initiatives involving enterprise software, cloud platforms, infrastructure, data analytics, and cybersecurity. Collaborates with technical engineering teams and functional stakeholders to ensure project deliverables, system integrations, and technical requirements remain aligned throughout the project lifecycle. Stakeholder Management & Organizational Change Partners with academic, administrative, and operational leaders to align technology solutions with departmental needs while actively managing project scope, risks, and conflicting priorities. Integrates structured organizational change management practices into project delivery to facilitate effective communication, end-user training, operational adoption, and sustainable transition to operational support. Project Intake, Prioritization & Continuous Improvement Leads the project intake, evaluation, and prioritization processes to assist leadership in assessing business value, technical complexity, budget impact, and resource feasibility. Directs post-implementation reviews and project retrospectives to systematically capture lessons learned, eliminate delivery roadblocks, and drive institutional process improvements. Education & Experience Minimum Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Administration, Project Management, Management Information Systems, or a related field. 5+ years of progressively responsible experience managing enterprise technology projects, programs, or project portfolios. 2+ years of leadership, supervisory, or significant team lead experience with responsibility for coaching and mentoring project professionals. Preferred Qualifications 7+ years of progressively responsible IT project or portfolio management experience, including three or more years of direct supervisory experience. Demonstrated experience leading a Project Management Office or enterprise technology portfolio within higher education or a complex public sector environment. Professional certification such as Project Management Professional (PMP), Certified ScrumMaster (CSM), or PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP). Demonstrated experience managing enterprise SaaS platforms, ERP systems, system integrations, and multi-campus technology migrations. Relevant experience may be considered in lieu of formal education where appropriate, consistent with TSTC’s equivalency philosophy. Skills & Abilities Demonstrated ability to lead, coach, and supervise professional project management staff to achieve high-quality project outcomes. In-depth knowledge of project and portfolio management frameworks across Agile, predictive, and hybrid delivery models. Strong enterprise technology acumen with the ability to bridge technical concepts and operational requirements for diverse audiences. Advanced analytical and problem-solving capabilities to identify dependencies, evaluate operational risks, and recommend sound solutions. Exceptional interpersonal, negotiation, and conflict-resolution skills to drive cross-functional alignment where direct reporting lines do not exist. Proven capability to lead organizational change management initiatives that support technology adoption and operational readiness. Strong organizational and prioritization skills to balance competing initiatives across a multi-campus college environment. Proficiency with enterprise work management and tracking platforms to maintain accurate project records and executive dashboards. Core Competencies Leadership & Team Development Leads with purpose, clarity, and visible commitment to institutional values while empowering team members to achieve high-performance results. Provides meaningful coaching, constructive feedback, and professional growth opportunities to build team capabilities and foster a resilient, service-oriented culture. Job Knowledge & Job Performance Applies deep technical and operational project management expertise to guide teams, solve complex institutional challenges, and deliver high-quality technology solutions. Maintains current knowledge of emerging industry standards, enterprise technologies, and governance practices to continually elevate departmental performance. Ownership & Accountability Takes ownership of team and portfolio outcomes, establishing clear expectations and holding project teams accountable for commitments, timelines, and budgets. Proactively navigates project challenges, makes sound risk-adjusted decisions, and maintains disciplined focus on institutional objectives. Teamwork & Service Cultivates cross-functional partnerships across academic, operational, and statewide departments to ensure shared understanding and customer satisfaction. Encourages an inclusive, collaborative team dynamic grounded in mutual respect, transparency, and responsive service delivery. Planning & Execution Translates organizational strategy into actionable project portfolio roadmaps while optimizing resource allocation and capacity management. Anticipates delivery bottlenecks, manages complex dependencies, and executes structured project plans with urgency, accuracy, and operational discipline. Technology Acumen & Innovation Applies a strong understanding of enterprise applications, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and system architecture to guide informed technology decisions. Champions continuous improvement and explores innovative tools and processes that enhance project delivery efficiency across the College. Additional duties may be assigned by leadership as needed. This position may be eligible for telework options in accordance with TSTC telework guidelines and State of Texas requirements. Work is generally performed in an office environment and requires regular use of computer equipment, active communication during standard business hours, and occasional work outside standard business hours during critical project deployments, renewals, or scheduled system outages. The role may require occasional travel to TSTC campuses, training events, or project meetings. title: Accounting and CyberAccounting, Department of Operations, Innovation, and Leadership - Adjunct Faculty
jd_text: Adjunct Faculty – Accounting & Cyber-Accounting Department of Operations, Innovation, and Leadership | University of Maryland Global Campus (UMGC) This position is specifically to teach remotely for stateside applicants. Local applicants only; UMGC does not sponsor logistical support for this role. Accounting Information Systems (ACCT 618): A study of the use of information systems in the accounting process, with an emphasis on computer systems and internal controls. Focus is on the analytical tools necessary to evaluate users' accounting information needs and to design, implement, and maintain an accounting information system to support business processes and cycles. Topics include the components of contemporary accounting information systems; security and internal controls, particularly within Internet and e-commerce environments; traditional flow charts and data-flow diagrams; computer networks; theory and application of relational databases; and relational database management systems. Assignments include designing an accounting information system using a commercial database software package. CyberAccounting: Management and Compliance (ACCT 620): An applied study of the principles of information systems management and their integration within private-sector organizations served by accounting professionals. Emphasis is on developing strategic cyber accounting initiatives to increase cybersecurity awareness inside organizations, with organizations in its supply chain, and with other stakeholders. Topics include cybersecurity compliance requirements issued by federal and state regulatory agencies and voluntary cybersecurity standards, such as the G-7 Fundamentals of Cybersecurity for the Financial Sector; and the AICPAs Cybersecurity's Risk Management Framework. Cyber Forensics in Accounting (ACCT 645): An applied study of the tools, techniques, and technologies used in forensic accounting investigations, data analytics, and litigation. Focus is on disentangling obscure evidence discovered during fraud investigations using data analytics. Activities include conducting a forensic accounting investigation, performing analytical tests on financial data, preparing written forensic accounting reports for legal proceedings, and serving as an expert witness providing testimony supported by evidence and analytical tests. Information Technology Auditing (ACCT 660): This course integrates subject matter from accounting and information systems program courses. Advanced principles, techniques, and theories are applied through the analysis and presentation of case studies by student teams. Assignments include a research paper that comprehensively assesses an important current issue or emerging trend in the fields off accounting and information systems. CyberAccounting: Risk Management (ACCT 670): A capstone exploration of the principles of risk management as practiced by federal, state, and local entities. Discussion examines cyber accounting risks management as promulgated by professional accounting organizations such as the AICPA. Risk management techniques are applied to cybersecurity issues confronting professional accounting service providers. Focus is on developing skills in assessing client risks, designing, and developing cybersecurity controls to mitigate cyber-attacks on client data, and conducting penetration tests to identify potential cyber accounting vulnerabilities. At UMGC, we don’t just teach; we empower . Founded in 1947, UMGC is an open-access, minority-serving institution serving over 90,000 nontraditional learners worldwide, including a proud, large military-affiliated population. Our students are mature, highly dedicated, and balancing careers, families, and service. As an Adjunct Faculty member, you are the essential partner helping them bridge the gap between classroom theory and real-world career success. Why Teach with UMGC? Focus on Students, Not Course Design: All courses follow a standardized, pre-designed, unified course model. Standardized rubrics, OER materials, library resources, and digital textbooks are fully provided at no cost to you. You get to focus 100% of your energy on mentoring, facilitating, and providing high-quality feedback—no unpaid course-building required. True Asynchronous Flexibility: Teach with flexibility, on your own schedule. As long as you meet weekly grading, responsiveness, and engagement milestones, your daily hours are entirely up to you. Ongoing Growth: We invest in you. All newly hired faculty receive comprehensive online orientation, alongside ongoing, cost-free professional development opportunities. The Rhythm of Your Week (Key Responsibilities) Adjunct faculty bring our pre-built curriculum to life through real-world expertise and active mentorship. Classroom Engagement & Presence Be Visible: Maintain an active classroom presence at least 5 days per week, introducing yourself with a welcome announcement and driving discussions. Bridge Theory & Practice: Enrich the pre-built curriculum with your own professional expertise and real-world examples. Build Belonging: Foster an inclusive, culturally responsive environment where adult learners feel supported and motivated. Responsiveness & Feedback Stay consistently engaged with learners throughout the course by responding to inquiries, returning feedback, and posting final grades within the expected timeframe. Proactive Support & Collaboration Monitor Progress: Use available data tools to track student engagement and conduct proactive outreach to at-risk students. Team Up: Partner with success coaches, academic staff, and portfolio directors to refer struggling students to UMGC support resources. Stay Connected: Participate in UMGC's vibrant faculty community, including the Program Hub and ongoing training. Course Structure & Time Commitment Format: 100% Online & Asynchronous Term Length: 8-week sessions (3-credit courses) Class Size: Typically, 25–35 students (smaller sections for select courses) Time Commitment: The adjunct faculty role requires a substantial commitment throughout the term focusing not only on academic success but also the social, personal, and professional growth of students Minimum Qualifications: Education: ​ A terminal degree (i.e., PhD, JD, DBA) in Business, Accounting, or a related field from an accredited institution of higher learning At least one certification in the cyber-security area from professional organizations, such as the ISACA-issued CISA Experience: Professional cybersecurity, auditing, compliance management, accounting, finance, and/or business experience Legal Status: Applicants must have and be able to maintain their own legal status in the country in which they apply to teach. The Mindset: A deeply student-centered approach rooted in empathy, flexibility, professional integrity, and cultural responsiveness. Active engagement in your discipline's professional community. jd_text: <p><strong>About the Revenue Operations Team</strong></p> <p>The OpenSesame Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone and growth catalyst of the company, enabling our Go-To-Market teams to sell, serve, and scale with clarity and confidence. We design the systems, processes, and insights that turn strategy into execution and ensure revenue flows efficiently from first conversation to renewal.</p> <p>We partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partners, Finance, and Legal to remove friction, enforce smart governance, and create a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Our work blends data, process, technology, and judgment to help the business move faster, without cutting corners.</p> <p><strong>What makes our Revenue Operations team unique:</strong></p> <ul> <li>We embrace <strong>automation and AI</strong> to reduce manual work, surface insights faster, and scale best practices.</li> <li>We invest deeply in <strong>operational excellence and continuous improvement</strong>, balancing speed with discipline.</li> <li>We are <strong>systems thinkers and problem solvers</strong>, motivated by making complex processes simpler and more scalable.</li> <li>We measure success by <strong>business outcomes</strong> — deal velocity, forecast accuracy, won revenue and customer experience.</li> <li>We operate with an <strong>owner’s mindset</strong>, taking accountability for results, not just activity.</li> <li>We do the right thing, even when it requires tough conversations or slowing down a deal to protect the business.</li> <li>We communicate with <strong>clarity and credibility</strong>, serving as trusted advisors to GTM teams and leadership.</li> <li>We believe the best results come from <strong>tight collaboration and shared learning</strong>, supporting one another through peer problem-solving, documentation, and knowledge-sharing so the entire organization gets better together.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Sales Operations Manager, Channel &amp; Partnerships role:</strong></p> <p>The <strong>Sales Operations Manager, Channel &amp; Partnerships</strong> is the operational partner responsible for helping OpenSesame scale its partner business with greater clarity, efficiency, accountability, and predictability.</p> <p>This role partners closely with Strategic Partner Managers, Partner Development, the Partner Program Manager, Revenue Operations, Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Legal, Enablement, Marketing, and Product to improve how partner-sourced, partner-influenced, reseller, OEM, referral, and co-sell motions operate from partner lead submission through quote-to-cash.</p> <p>This is a manager-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role requires manager-level judgment, strong business partnership, analytical depth, and the ability to influence change through process, data, systems, automation, and AI-enabled workflows.&nbsp;This is not a reporting-only role or a tactical support desk. The right person will diagnose partner process friction, improve tool adoption, clarify ownership, strengthen partner attribution, and turn messy data into actionable insights that help the partner business grow.</p> <p>Success in this role means partner leaders trust the data, Partner Sales Managers have clear operating views, partners submit leads through the right platform, quote-to-cash processes are understood, and leadership can clearly see what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus next.</p> <p><strong>Performance Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>Within 30 Days: Understand, Diagnose, and Prioritize</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a deep understanding of OpenSesame’s partner ecosystem, including reseller, OEM, referral, partner-sourced, partner-influenced, and co-sell motions.</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with Partner Sales Managers, Partner Development, the Partner Program Manager, Sales, Finance, Business Systems, Legal, Enablement, Marketing, Product, and RevOps.</li> <li>Audit current partner lead submission, routing, attribution, opportunity management, handoff, reporting, and quote-to-cash processes.</li> <li>Assess adoption and utilization of key partner tools and workflows, including Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, Gong, Looker, ZoomInfo, Clay, and related GTM systems.</li> <li>Identify friction points impacting partner lead submission, partner visibility, SPM productivity, reporting accuracy, quote-to-cash execution, and forecast confidence.</li> <li>Deliver a current-state assessment with prioritized recommendations, including quick wins and longer-term operating improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 60 Days: Improve Process, Visibility, and Adoption</strong></p> <ul> <li>Refine partner lead and opportunity workflows to improve routing accuracy, attribution, pipeline visibility, and accountability.</li> <li>Establish clearer standards for partner lead submission through Euler, including required fields, SLAs, review process, ownership, and follow-up expectations.</li> <li>Improve use of Crossbeam to support account mapping, overlap analysis, co-sell opportunity identification, partner prioritization, and joint pipeline visibility.</li> <li>Build or improve reporting views for Partner Sales Managers, Partner Development, Partner Program leadership, Sales leadership, Finance, and RevOps.</li> <li>Partner with Business Systems to scope CRM, Euler, Crossbeam, and workflow improvements that reduce manual work and improve data quality.</li> <li>Identify automation or AI-enabled opportunities to streamline partner operations, improve lead hygiene, summarize partner performance, or surface pipeline risk faster.</li> <li>Align with Enablement and the Partner Program Manager on internal and partner-facing communication, training, and adoption reinforcement.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Beyond 90 Days: Scale Partner Operations and Strategic Impact</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own ongoing operational health across partner lead submission, attribution, opportunity management, reporting, and quote-to-cash workflows.</li> <li>Build durable reporting that helps leadership understand partner pipeline quality, conversion, revenue contribution, account overlap, and growth opportunities.</li> <li>Surface insights on partner performance, partner fit, source quality, deal velocity, conversion, attribution, and partner profitability.</li> <li>Support Partner Development with data-backed insights to identify, prioritize, and evaluate potential new partners.</li> <li>Support Partner Sales Managers with clear views into partner account activity, pipeline, performance, whitespace, and expansion opportunities.</li> <li>Partner with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, and Sales to improve operational clarity across OEM and reseller quote-to-cash processes.</li> <li>Drive measurable improvements in tool adoption, workflow efficiency, partner lead compliance, reporting accuracy, and partner pipeline visibility.</li> <li>Be viewed by Partner leadership as a trusted operating partner who brings clarity, urgency, and practical solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ongoing Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Partner Pipeline, Attribution &amp; Rules of Engagement</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own operational visibility into partner-sourced, partner-influenced, reseller, OEM, referral, and co-sell pipeline.</li> <li>Improve partner lead submission, routing, tracking, and attribution across Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, and related systems.</li> <li>Support and operationalize partner attribution rules, including source, influence, referral, reseller, OEM, and co-sell motions.</li> <li>Help maintain partner rules of engagement, including lead submission requirements, ownership, AE/SPM handoff expectations, response SLAs, conflict resolution, and exception handling.</li> <li>Identify attribution gaps, duplicate submissions, unclear ownership, inconsistent crediting, stale opportunities, or missing partner data.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Tool Adoption, Automation &amp; AI</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive adoption of partner tools and workflows by making processes clear, useful, and easy to follow for internal teams and external partners.</li> <li>Diagnose friction across Euler, Crossbeam, Salesforce, reporting, handoffs, and quote-to-cash workflows.</li> <li>Partner with Business Systems, Analytics, and Enablement to scope, test, and roll out system or workflow improvements.</li> <li>Identify opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and surface insights faster.</li> <li>Explore use cases such as partner performance summaries, lead quality checks, account overlap insights, partner QBR prep, pipeline risk alerts, quote-to-cash prompts, and executive reporting.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Reporting, Analytics &amp; Strategic Insights</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain reporting that helps Partner leadership understand what is working, what is at risk, and where to focus.</li> <li>Analyze partner pipeline, conversion, sales cycle, win rates, deal velocity, source quality, attribution, account overlap, and revenue contribution.</li> <li>Support partner QBRs, business reviews, annual planning, and performance discussions with clear, data-backed insights.</li> <li>Translate messy or incomplete data into executive-ready recommendations: what changed, why it changed, what is at risk, and what action is recommended.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Partner Program, Planning &amp; Growth Support</strong></p> <ul> <li>Support the Partner Program Manager with operational infrastructure for partner tiers, program rules, incentives, enablement, compliance, and performance measurement.</li> <li>Support Partner Development with analysis to identify and prioritize prospective partners based on fit, account overlap, market opportunity, and revenue potential.</li> <li>Support Partner Sales Managers in managing and expanding partner relationships through account visibility, pipeline insights, partner activity reporting, and process clarity.</li> <li>Build visibility across the partner lifecycle, including recruitment, onboarding, enablement, activation, pipeline creation, revenue contribution, and expansion.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Quote-to-Cash &amp; Cross-Functional Operations</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build operational understanding of quote-to-cash requirements across OEM, reseller, referral, and other partner motions.</li> <li>Partner with Finance, Legal, Deal Desk, Business Systems, and Sales to clarify requirements, reduce friction, and improve handoffs.</li> <li>Improve visibility into partner deal economics, including discounts, reseller margins, referral fees, OEM terms, payment obligations, and revenue recognition considerations where applicable.</li> <li>Translate business needs into clear requirements for process, reporting, systems, and enablement improvements.</li> </ul> <p>You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.</p> <p>We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job, that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve made OpenSesame better, faster, and stronger because of your leadership.</p> <p>Although it should go without saying (but it doesn’t), OpenSesame is an equal opportunity employer and we strive to create a welcoming, inclusive environment that celebrates diversity.</p> <p><strong>We use AI. For real.&nbsp;</strong>Every team at OpenSesame works with AI tools daily, not as a buzzword, but as practice. You'll build fluency that most companies are still talking about adopting, with hands-on training and clear guardrails to experiment responsibly. AI amplifies your creativity and judgment. It doesn't replace them. The skills you build here travel with you.</p> <p><strong>Location:&nbsp;</strong>This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company, and invest in mandatory all-company meetings several times a year in addition to required team travel as necessary.</p> <p><strong>Performance Driven:&nbsp;</strong>We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. We don't focus on typical job requirements, instead, we're interested in specific examples from your past experiences. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>: The base salary for this role ranges between $135,000 and $150,000 per year, depending on experience. At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off. We carefully consider a wide range of compensation factors, relying on market data to determine compensation and consider your specific job family, background, skills, and experience.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits:</strong> Benefits include comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible PTO, 401(k) matching, incentive stock options, volunteer time off, Employee Resource Groups, and a generous professional development program with dedicated annual time off for learning and growth.</p> <p><strong>Equal Employment Opportunity</strong>: OpenSesame is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer that values and welcomes diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of various legally protected characteristics, including criminal history, and strive to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities. We prioritize safety and security and may use your information accordingly, and you can contact us for assistance or accommodations during the job application process.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Pay Transparency</strong>: At OpenSesame, we prioritize pay transparency, fairness, and equity to create a positive and inclusive work environment, regularly reviewing our compensation practices to align with our values and goals. We provide competitive and fair compensation to our employees based on their skills, experience, and performance.</p> <p><strong>CPRA</strong> (California Candidates): When you submit your application, OpenSesame may collect and use your personal information in accordance with our privacy policy and the CPRA. This may include personal details and employment history, and will only be used for employment-related purposes. We may share this information with third-party service providers, but we will not sell it to third parties. If you have any questions or concerns, please contact us, and for more information on your rights under the CPRA, refer to our<a href="https://www.opensesame.com/privacy"> privacy policy</a> or the California Attorney General's website.</p>

title: Product Manager, Embedded Experience Platform
jd_text: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Role overview: The Product Manager, Embedded Digital Experiences & Content Platform will support the development of scalable digital capabilities that enable premium benefit experiences across embedded partner environments and other digital channels. This role will help define platform capabilities for content organization, benefit discovery, eligibility, personalization, publishing workflows, localization, reporting, implementation support, and operational readiness. The role will partner across product, technology, design, regional, marketing, operations, compliance, and client-facing teams to deliver consistent, reusable, accessible, and scalable experiences for clients, partners, and consumers. Key responsibilities: Define product requirements for embedded digital experiences, including partner integration patterns, benefit discovery, eligibility capabilities, content delivery, implementation documentation, reporting needs, and operational readiness. Support development of scalable content capabilities that enable content to be organized, managed, reviewed, localized, personalized, published, governed, and measured across multiple digital channels. Translate business and client needs into clear product requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release priorities, and success metrics. Partner with engineering and architecture teams to define reusable platform capabilities, API requirements, onboarding flows, service expectations, compliance considerations, operational support needs, and release plans. Develop content platform requirements such as content taxonomy, metadata, publishing workflows, localization, accessibility, lifecycle management, governance processes, compliance review support, and performance measurement. Prioritize platform capabilities across client demand, regional needs, user experience, scalability, operational complexity, governance, risk considerations, and engineering capacity. Work with cross-functional teams to ensure embedded experiences and content capabilities are designed for consistency, flexibility, accessibility, reliability, compliance readiness, and ease of implementation. Help define product documentation and enablement materials, including integration guides, capability overviews, implementation checklists, pilot readiness materials, and stakeholder updates. Use data and feedback to evaluate product performance, identify opportunities for improvement, and inform future roadmap priorities. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications 8+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 5 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 2 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 11+ years of relevant work experience. Preferred Qualifications 5+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8+ years of relevant work experience. ( 6+ years of product management experience in one or more of the following areas: platform products, digital experiences, developer products, APIs, content platforms, loyalty, benefits, payments, or enterprise integrations. Experience working on public-facing digital products, embedded experiences, or content capabilities where consistency, accessibility, localization, governance, compliance review, and operational quality are important. Familiarity with content lifecycle management, including taxonomy, metadata, publishing workflows, localization, personalization, compliance coordination, measurement, and continuous optimization. Strong technical fluency with APIs, platform services, data exchange, implementation documentation, and enterprise-grade product operations. Experience defining MVP scope, release sequencing, acceptance criteria, onboarding requirements, success metrics, and measurable product outcomes. Strong judgment on tradeoffs between scalability, customization, governance, accessibility, operational efficiency, commercial value, and user experience. Ability to work closely with engineering, design, operations, compliance, regional, and business stakeholders while translating complex requirements into clear product choices. Excellent communication skills and ability to produce clear, structured, executive-ready documentation. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $133,300.00 to $ 213,400.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Product Manager, Strategy & Growth
jd_text: <p><strong>Product Manager, Strategy &amp; Growth</strong></p> <p><strong>About OpenSesame</strong></p> <p>OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.<br>Learn more: <a href="http://www.opensesame.com/about">www.opensesame.com/about</a></p> <p><strong>About the Job</strong></p> <p>AI, new workforce models, and changing approaches to talent development are reshaping how organizations develop their people. These shifts create opportunities for OpenSesame that extend beyond individual product features to new products, markets, partnerships, business models, and roles we can play in the learning and workforce ecosystem.</p> <p>As Product Manager, Strategy &amp; Growth, you will identify and validate where OpenSesame can create new customer and business value. You will combine customer insight, market intelligence, emerging technology, and commercial thinking to shape product strategy and drive new growth.</p> <p>This is a hands-on, AI-forward role. You will use AI extensively to accelerate research, analysis, prototyping, and experimentation—but your focus will be broader than AI products. Your job is to anticipate where the future of work and learning is heading, test where OpenSesame has the right to win, and turn the strongest opportunities into products and businesses.</p> <p><strong>Performance-Based Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>30 Days — Build the Opportunity Map</strong></p> <ul> <li>Complete 15+ customer and stakeholder interviews focused on unmet needs, changing buying behaviors, and the future of enterprise learning.</li> <li>Deliver a market and competitive assessment covering major shifts in AI, workforce development, skills, learning technology, and adjacent markets.</li> <li>Present a prioritized opportunity map identifying 3–5 areas for further validation, supported by customer, market, and business evidence.</li> <li>Build at least one prototype or concept to begin testing a high-potential opportunity with customers.</li> </ul> <p><strong>60 Days — Validate the Best Opportunities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Run customer experiments against the 3 highest-priority opportunities using prototypes, interviews, data, or other appropriate tests.</li> <li>Produce an evidence-based assessment of each opportunity covering customer value, differentiation, market potential, feasibility, and business model.</li> <li>Test pricing, packaging, partnership, or distribution hypotheses for opportunities with commercial potential.</li> <li>Recommend which opportunities to advance, modify, or stop based on evidence.</li> </ul> <p><strong>90 Days — Turn Opportunities into a Roadmap</strong></p> <ul> <li>Deliver a roadmap with specific experiments and investments across 3 developing areas where OpenSesame could create significant new customer and business value.</li> <li>Define the customer problem, strategic rationale, business packaging, partnership, and GTM recommendations for initiatives approaching market validation.</li> </ul> <p><strong>6 Months — Prove Market Potential</strong></p> <ul> <li>Move at least 2 strategic opportunities from hypothesis through customer validation and market testing.</li> <li>Launch or pilot at least one new product, offering, partnership, or business model with customers.</li> <li>Deliver measurable evidence of adoption, willingness to pay, revenue potential, retention impact, or strategic differentiation.</li> <li>Present investment recommendations for scaling, iterating, or stopping each initiative based on results.</li> </ul> <p>You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. If you’re motivated to learn, comfortable with experimentation, and excited about how technology can make sales more human, you’ll fit right in.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Compensation</strong>: The base salary for this role ranges between $160,000 and $180,000 per year, depending on experience. jd_text: Are you someone who strives for excellence, values accountability, provides the best service, all while reflecting unwavering integrity? Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders to plan, coordinate, and execute complex initiatives. Five years of experience in project management, operational improvement, organizational effectiveness, or related work involving complex cross-functional initiatives. Experience in higher education, workforce development, public sector operations, or another complex multi-stakeholder environment. Experience supporting executive-level planning, organizational change, or divisional strategy implementation. Ability to analyze operational workflows, identify performance gaps, and develop and implement process improvement strategies. Ability to think strategically and develop innovative, practical, and sustainable solutions to operational challenges. Ability to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into actionable recommendations. Ability to collect, analyze, and present data and metrics to measure project impact and prepare reports and recommendations for leadership. title: Data Engineering Manager
jd_text: <p><strong>About OpenSesame</strong></p> <p>OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.<br>Learn more: <a href="http://www.opensesame.com/about" target="_blank">www.opensesame.com/about</a></p> <p><strong>About the Team</strong></p> <p>The Data Engineering Manager will guide and grow a lean, focused data engineering team. The team’s mission is to build and scale an AI-ready data foundation that enables reliable analytics, operational reporting, governance, enterprise system integrations, and future AI initiatives across the company. This role partners closely with analysts, business leaders, engineering teams, product management, and data consumers company-wide to improve the accessibility, trust, and usability of enterprise data assets.</p> <p><strong>About the Role&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Data Engineering Manager I, you will combine direct people management, team stewardship, operational execution, and technical decision-making. You will own the Data Governance &amp; Accessibility program while serving as the managerial and architectural lead responsible for designing scalable data systems, improving pipeline reliability, and enabling analysts through robust, specialized data solutions.</p> <p>Success in this role requires balancing high-impact people management (1:1s, performance management, career development) with strategic planning, cross-functional stakeholder management, agile process facilitation, and technical leadership.</p> <p><strong>Core Responsibilities &amp; Management Expectations</strong></p> <p><strong>People Management &amp; Mentorship</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Direct Supervision:</strong> Conduct effective 1:1s, set clear goals, deliver regular performance feedback, and manage career growth for direct reports.</li> <li><strong>Engineering Culture:</strong> Foster a psychologically safe team environment built on trust, transparency, continuous improvement, and a growth mindset.</li> <li><strong>Team Upskilling:</strong> Actively mentor engineers in data engineering best practices, design patterns, testing strategies, and operational discipline.</li> </ul> <p><strong>&nbsp;Team Leadership &amp; Process Stewardship</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Delivery &amp; Execution:</strong> Act as a team steward, driving execution, managing team velocity, breaking down bottlenecks, and maintaining operational sustainability.</li> <li><strong>Agile &amp; Work Management:</strong> Facilitate planning, standups, and prioritization; partner with data analysts and business leaders to translate business needs into well-defined, incremental stories.</li> <li><strong>Process Critique &amp; Improvement:</strong> Regularly evaluate team processes to refine norms and eliminate friction.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Cross-Functional Collaboration &amp; Stakeholder Alignment</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Stakeholder Enablement:</strong> Serve as the primary technical contact for analytics and business leaders to ensure data enablement across departments.</li> <li><strong>Project Communication:</strong> Maintain radical transparency on team roadmaps, risks, delays, and progress.</li> <li><strong>Business &amp; Strategy Alignment:</strong> Translate complex technical concepts into business terms for cross-functional partners and leadership.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Technical Governance &amp; Architecture Leadership</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>AI-Ready Platform Architecture:</strong> Direct the design and scale of our Snowflake-based data platform, ingestion architecture, and AI interface layers.</li> <li><strong>Enterprise Integrations:</strong> Oversee seamless data ingestion from core systems (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, NetSuite, Zendesk, Jira, Confluence) into a centralized, queryable source of truth.</li> <li><strong>Data Governance &amp; Observability:</strong> Establish company-wide standards for data ownership, access management, lineage visibility, testing/validation, and automated pipeline monitoring.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>Within 30 Days</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Team &amp; Management Foundation:</strong> Establish recurring 1:1s with direct reports, assess team dynamics and individual skill sets, and align on individual goals and development paths.</li> <li><strong>Stakeholder Mapping:</strong> Build working relationships with key cross-functional stakeholders to map out current data dependencies, pain points, and reporting workflows.</li> <li><strong>Full Data Ecosystem Audit:</strong> Conduct a comprehensive audit of the end-to-end data stack (<strong>Snowflake, Fivetran, dbt, Looker, etc.</strong>) to evaluate cloud spend, pipeline reliability, data transformations, data quality gaps, and constraints for future AI initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 60 Days</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Operational Execution:</strong> Refine team operating rhythms (planning, standups, retro) and prioritization processes to improve delivery transparency and reduce operational friction for analytics requests.</li> <li><strong>Standards &amp; Quick Wins:</strong> Define foundational engineering standards (code review, dbt testing/modeling guidelines, monitoring/alerting) and implement 1–2 quick wins to improve immediate pipeline reliability.</li> <li><strong>Architectural Options Drafting:</strong> Draft initial proposals for a modernized, cost-effective data architecture across ingestion, transformation, and storage, evaluating trade-offs between current tooling, usage-based pricing, and AI integration requirements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 90 Days</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Architecture Recommendation: </strong>Deliver a formal, well-documented recommendation for a modernized data architecture across the entire stack that optimizes tool and infrastructure costs, improves processing efficiency, and provides a scalable foundation for AI solutions.</li> <li><strong>Self-Service &amp; Governance:</strong> Establish company-wide standards for data ownership, lineage tracking, and access management to promote secure self-service analytics.</li> <li><strong>Team Maturity:</strong> Demonstrate measurable improvements in delivery consistency, pipeline reliability, analyst trust, and structured team mentorship.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Within 6 Months</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Phase 1 Platform Implementation:</strong> Successfully execute the initial phase of the approved architecture recommendation, delivering core, production-ready pipelines and well-documented datasets.</li> <li><strong>High-Performing Culture:</strong> Build an engineering culture centered on technical excellence, operational discipline, psychological safety, and clear ownership.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Value:</strong> Position the data engineering function as a proactive, strategic enabler for company-wide AI and data initiatives.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Success in the Role Looks Like</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Empowered Team:</strong> Direct reports feel supported, clear on expectations, and are actively growing in their technical and professional skills.</li> <li><strong>Trusted Enterprise Data:</strong> Analysts across the organization reliably access trusted, well-documented datasets with minimal operational friction.</li> <li><strong>Robust Observability:</strong> Data pipelines run with high reliability, clear SLAs, and proactive alerting.</li> <li><strong>AI-Ready Ecosystem:</strong> The enterprise data platform cleanly supports AI/LLM experimentation and plain-language analytics without requiring major re-architecting.</li> <li><strong>Strategic Partnership:</strong> Stakeholders across OpenSesame view the data engineering team as a collaborative, highly effective driver of business value.</li> </ul> <p>You might notice we don’t list a traditional set of requirements or buzzwords here. That’s intentional.</p> <p>We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can build brands, create scalable systems, and drive measurable marketing impact. When you look back a year from now, you’ll know you’ve elevated OpenSesame’s brand and strengthened its market presence.</p> <p><strong>Location</strong>: This position can be based anywhere in the US. We operate as a remote-first company and invest in all-company in-person meetings several times a year.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Performance Driven</strong>: We're looking for self-starters with a track record of delivering excellent results, but we're highly selective about who we hire. All positions can be based anywhere in the US, and require up to 15 days of travel per year, with senior management and leadership teams requiring up to 35 days.</p> <p><strong>Compensation: </strong>The salary for this role range between $180,000 - $208,000&nbsp; per year, depending on experience.<strong> </strong>At OpenSesame, we offer a comprehensive benefits package to employees upon hire, including professional development, ISOs, health insurance, 401(k) matching, and paid time off.
