Our mission is to connect the world through the most innovative, convenient, reliable, and secure payments network. We empower individuals, businesses, and economies to thrive, driven by a common purpose – to uplift everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and get paid. Make a meaningful impact with a purpose-driven industry leader. Join us today and experience Life at Visa. Global Sourcing Visa’s Global Sourcing organization, a key part of our Global Finance function, oversees the comprehensive sourcing and procurement of goods and services. Our team collaborates with technology partners and business units to lead all strategic sourcing activities worldwide, ensuring the optimal selection of suppliers that deliver best-in-class value in price and quality while minimizing risk. We support the business with risk management, supplier negotiations & contracting, purchase order processes, and accounts payable to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and corporate policies. Our efforts are crucial in delivering cost savings and streamlining the procurement of goods and services. Team Overview As part of Visa’s Global Sourcing function, the Center of Excellence (CoE) team serves as a foundational capability for the Sourcing function, and enables the function’s success through people, process, program and operational management best practices. The CoE will drive consistency, clarity, and strong execution — while maintaining flexibility to meet business and regional needs, and focuses on four core areas: · Value & Strategic Sourcing Enablement · Process & Systems Excellence · Talent & Change Enablement · Policy, Risk & Contract Governance This role reports to the Director of Global Sourcing Data & Insights within COE. The Global Sourcing Data & Insights team empowers the Global Sourcing organization with data, dashboards, and analytical tools that help measure performance, identify savings opportunities, uncover operational insights, inform strategic decisions, and drive continuous improvement. The team is responsible for designing end-to-end data solutions, defining and analyzing business-critical KPIs, developing scalable data products and advanced reporting capabilities, and enabling self-service analytics across the sourcing organization. Through strong partnerships with business, finance, and technology teams, we help transform data into actionable insights that drive measurable business value.. Job Description Overview As the Data & Insights Analyst, you will play a pivotal role in developing and managing analytical products and reporting that provide visibility into business performance across the Global Sourcing organization, while serving as a strategic thought partner to sourcing and finance leaders. You will drive the design and execution of scalable analytics solutions, data products, and reporting capabilities that influence organizational direction and deliver measurable business value. You will own the development of data visualizations, dashboards, and analytical solutions, enabling category leaders to quickly digest information, identify opportunities for improvement, and make decisions. You will gather, extract, and transform data from various financial systems, then develop compelling and accurate dashboards for the global sourcing team. In this role, you will partner cross-functionally with many organizations, including category leaders within the global sourcing team, the IT team that manages the enterprise application, and the Finance team that defines our financial data. As a member of the global team, your stakeholders and colleagues will be located across the globe in different time zones. Your expertise will be critical in fostering a data-driven culture, championing best practices in data governance, and elevating the quality and strategic use of data throughout the Global Sourcing organization. Responsibilities: Insights & Reporting Design and maintain reusable data products, semantic models, and analytical datasets that enable self-service reporting and analytics across the organization. Design, develop and deliver sophisticated dashboards, reports, and analytical models that monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and provide actionable insights and support strategic decision-making. Deliver reports and analyses that highlight trends, identify opportunities, and answer critical business questions. Maintain and enhance the existing dashboard suite to ensure data accuracy and completeness, address user questions, and improve the user interface experience. Prepare ad hoc reporting and analysis for specific initiatives, collaborating with category leads and analysts as needed. Identify opportunities to automate reporting, analysis, and business processes using modern analytics, AI, and workflow automation technologies. Stakeholder Engagement & Collaboration Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to identify opportunities, solve business problems, and translate objectives into actionable analytics initiatives. Partner with IT and business stakeholders to define data requirements, ensure the availability and quality of source data, and develop scalable, reusable data products and datasets using sound data architecture principles to advance enterprise analytics capabilities. Drive adoption of analytics solutions by partnering with stakeholders, gathering feedback, conducting enablement sessions, and continuously improving user experience. Data Governance & Best Practices Champion best data practices across the organization by developing protocols and governance to ensure data accuracy and consistency. Proactively provide training to improve data consistency, awareness, and effective data usage across the organization. This role is a Hybrid position to be located in our Austin, TX office location with expectations of being in office 3 days per week. Expectations of days in office will be aligned with the hiring team. This role is not approved for any relocation assistance or sponsorship. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD) Demonstrated success in leading cross functional initiatives and driving process or technology adoption at scale. Strong project management skills, with the ability to prioritize and deliver multiple high impact projects in a fast-paced environment. Experience working with enterprise data warehouses, semantic models, star schemas, and curated analytics datasets. Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models. Advanced proficiency in SQL and relational databases. Deep expertise in data visualization platforms such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker. Ability to quickly learn and adapt to new tools, technologies, and software platforms. Excellent communication and executive presence, with the ability to synthesize information, make concise recommendations, and influence senior leaders. Strategic thinker with a passion for leveraging data to drive impact and create value. Demonstrated intellectual curiosity and a passion for solving complex, ambiguous business problems through the effective use of data. Thrives in a fast-paced environment with a commitment to continuous learning, innovation, and improvement. Preferred Qualifications: 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) Bachelor’s degree in a STEM/Finance field required. Advanced degree (Master’s, MBA, or equivalent) in Data Analytics or a related discipline strongly preferred. 4+ years of progressive experience in business analytics, with 6+ years preferred. Experience supporting operations, finance, supply chain, sourcing, or related functions is preferred. Experience with Python is a plus. Experience with workflow automation tools such as Power Automate is a plus. Experience working with modern cloud data platforms such as Azure, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or equivalent technologies is a plus. Experience leveraging GenAI tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate analytics, automation, software development, and business productivity. title: Manager, Sourcing Operations, App/Eq./Pack
jd_text: About your role: You will lead a team of specialists responsible to oversee the day-to-day production operations across assigned locations at T1 factories. This role acts as the first line of escalation, supports on production issues troubleshooting and collaborates closely with VF functional teams and Factory partners to drive performance on Quality, OTP and Social/Environmental Compliance. Additionally, you will support on driving continuous process improvement, championing change, and fostering a culture of operational excellence and innovation. This position requires frequent travel to factory sites across the designated locations within the country. This role is ideal for a results-driven professional with strong production operational acumen and leadership capabilities. Success in this role depends on the ability to collaborate effectively, build strong internal and external relationships, and champion continuous improvement. Your responsibilities will include (but not limited): • Lead and develop a team of specialists, coach performance and support professional growth; • Manage a portfolio of factories within the assigned country, ensuring core KPIs are consistently met or exceeded; • Actively contribute on Risk Assessment (TD) and Pre-Production (T4) meetings by identifying risks and recommending actions to safeguard product quality and performance, ensuring alignment with brand standards and industry best practices. Promote a “Speak-up” culture. • Take full accountability for resolving production-related issues (e.g., material delays, low output) in close collaboration with VF functions and Factory partners. • Participate in root cause analysis and CAP reviews for quality claims with the QM team. Facilitate CAP implementation and ensure effectiveness of actions implemented • Support the RSO (Responsible Sourcing Ops) team in driving the completion of social/environmental compliance corrective action plans and assist in implementing VF’s environmental and social programs (e.g., Higg Index, WCD, LABS). • Co-lead the automation strategy with the Commercialization team and support factories in adopting lean manufacturing and best-in-class practices; • Leverage data analytics to improve factory performance and efficiency. • Maintain strong relationships with cross-functional partners and act as the key contact point for operational escalations; • Stay informed of industry trends, material innovations, and manufacturing best practices. • Promote a culture of compliance, accountability, and continuous improvement under the guidance of the VF Values. Embrace the VF “Winning Together” culture in every interaction with your direct reports, internal stakeholders and cross-functional teams. What we will be looking for in you: • Knowledge of the product category within the scope of this role with proven experience - deep understanding of manufacturing processes, materials, and construction methods; • You will be coaching and developing your team, providing timely constructive feedback enabling them to excel and realize their potential. • Proven leadership experience in managing multi-cultural teams and ability to influence stakeholders to advance business goals. • Drive and passion to make a difference, presenting a growth mindset that role models positivity and curiosity to your team and peers. • Ability to lead, facilitate and champion change. • Product Development or Technical expertise will be an advantage. Key Attributes: • Embodies the highest level of personal and professional integrity and ethics. • Passion for product and a consumer-first mindset; • Able to manage complex and conflicting interpersonal interactions with others, solve problems, make decisions and work effectively under pressure. • Possesses excellent organizational and analytical skills and prioritize and can successfully execute multiple tasks/projects. • Able to collaborate with peers and superiors while building relationships with individuals and organizations across the globe. • Culturally sensitive and aware. • Demonstrates a creative, energetic, and motivated spirit. Desirable Qualifications & Competencies: • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Supply Chain, Business, or related field. MBA is a plus; • Minimum 8-10 years of experience in the field of production operations, with at least 3 years in a managerial role; • Experience working with overseas factories, and a multi-cultural factory management team; • Proven experience in leading & developing team. • Proficient in Microsoft Office, PLM systems, and production planning tools. • Fluent in English (written and Verbal) additional languages (Vietnamese, Khmer, Mandarin) are a plus. • Willingness and ability to travel extensively within the region. Engineers design and implement multi-agent orchestration frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, tool-calling integrations, and LLM inference services — all at enterprise scale on on-premise infrastructure. Key Responsibilities: Collaborate with stakeholders to interpret requirements for project components and incorporate feedback into future designs or solution fixes. Translate business requirements by verifying assumptions and escalating potential design issues to appropriate stakeholders. Participate in system design and architecture, refining code plans and contributing to design documentation. Contribute to project estimation and escalate issues that may cause delays. Develop, implement, and maintain code for products, services, or components, applying coding patterns, guidelines, and best practices. Apply debugging tools to verify assumptions and proactively flag issues before they occur. Participate in code reviews to ensure coding standards are followed and address routine pull requests. Create test plans and configure testing procedures to identify and resolve defects for multiple features. Respond to support requests during on-call rotations, troubleshooting issues and deploying fixes under guidance. Leverage and build knowledge of software developer tools to create, debug, and maintain code for components. Remain current in skills by investing time in training resources to improve product availability, reliability, efficiency, observability, and performance. AI & Agentic Systems Design, implement, and tune multi-agent LLM workflows using agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LangGraph4j, LangChain4j), including declarative graph compilation, conditional routing between agent nodes, state persistence, and dynamic agent spawning at runtime. Build and maintain ReAct (Reasoning + Acting) agent loops — iterative Reason→Act→Observe cycles in which an LLM selects tools, interprets tool results, and continues until a terminal answer is produced. Implement Supervisor/Orchestrator agent patterns where a Lead Agent dynamically plans, spawns, and coordinates Specialist Sub-Agents using conditional graph edges and tool frameworks. Develop MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool servers that expose enterprise data sources as callable tools for AI agents, enabling natural-language-driven access to structured backend systems. Implement and refine RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines: document ingestion and chunking (PDF/Word), embedding generation, vector storage (e.g., PostgreSQL + pgvector), and semantic similarity retrieval to ground LLM responses in authoritative source documents. Integrate with enterprise LLM inference gateways via REST APIs, including request shaping, prompt template management, token budget control, and graceful degradation under service unavailability. Design and implement agent memory architectures — both short-term per-agent isolated context stores and long-term shared knowledge repositories used across agent workflows. Build confidence scoring and uncertainty quantification mechanisms for AI-generated outputs, including threshold-based routing of low-confidence results to human review. Implement agent feedback loops — capturing human reviewer decisions and feeding structured corrections back into prompt templates and knowledge repositories to continuously improve model behavior. Write LangChain4j / LangChain tool definitions (e.g., Java @Tool-annotated methods) and wire them into ReAct agents for data transformation, external API calls, and domain-specific processing. Build and maintain agentic audit trails — structured logs capturing every tool call, agent decision, LLM prompt/response, and state transition for traceability and explainability. Develop and test Spring Boot microservices (Java 21, Spring Boot 3.5.x) that host AI orchestration engines, expose REST APIs for downstream consumers, and integrate with upstream data source systems. Author and maintain Helm charts and Jenkins CI/CD pipelines for containerized deployment of AI services to Kubernetes/OpenShift clusters across multi-region on-premise data centers. Build end-to-end and integration tests for non-deterministic AI components — including prompt regression suites, tool call mock frameworks, agent output schema validators, and determinism gates to catch silent prompt drift before production. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Experience in technologies/software systems or a directly related field (minimum two years). Experience in developing and/or implementing web-based or mobile applications (minimum two years). Experience in system design and architecture for product components. Experience in debugging and troubleshooting software issues. Experience in code review and applying coding standards. Experience in test planning and execution for software features. Experience in responding to support requests and deploying fixes. Experience in using software developer tools for code creation and maintenance. Experience developing backend services in Java (Java 17+ preferred; Java 21 a strong plus). Familiarity with REST API design, Spring Boot, and JPA/ORM-based data access patterns. Foundational understanding of LLM APIs — prompt construction, token limits, and response parsing. Experience building and testing enterprise-scale web services (minimum one year). Experience working on client-facing project or technical teams (minimum one year). Experience in integrating feedback into design and solution fixes. Experience in mentoring junior engineers and collaborating with cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience building agentic AI systems using LangGraph, LangChain, LangGraph4j, or LangChain4j — specifically multi-agent graph construction, node/edge definitions, conditional routing, and state schema design. Experience implementing the React prompting pattern (Thought → Action → Observation) in a production or near-production LLM application. Working knowledge of Model Context Protocol (MCP) — server registration, tool schema definition (tools/list, tools/call), and client-side integration. Experience building RAG pipelines: document chunking strategies, embedding models, vector database querying (pgvector, Pinecone, Weaviate, or equivalent), and retrieval relevance tuning. Experience with prompt engineering — including structured output enforcement (JSON schema), chain-of-thought prompting, few-shot example design, and system prompt management. Experience building and monitoring LLM observability — tracking token usage, latency per agent step, tool call success rates, and output quality metrics in production. Experience with PostgreSQL including the pgvector extension for embedding storage and similarity search. Experience deploying containerized workloads on Kubernetes or OpenShift, including Helm chart authoring, rolling deployments, and health probes. Experience designing audit logging for AI agent decisions — capturing inputs, reasoning traces, tool calls, and outputs in a structured, queryable format. title: Turbine/Generator Project Manager - Comanche Peak
jd_text: If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online. Job Summary The Turbine/Generator Project Manager provides project management of turbine generator and auxiliary systems maintenance, including modifications, upgrades, installations, maintenance during the preparation for and execution of plant outages. The project manager ensures projects are completed on time, within budget, meeting high standards of quality and customer satisfaction. Responsibilities include: Developing and maintaining the Turbine/Generator Long Range Plan. Leading and managing turbine generator projects, coordinating internal and external resources, while ensuring project deliverables are achieved safely within the approved scope, cost, and schedule. Leading the project from requirements definition through implementation, identifying schedules, scopes, budget estimations, and implementation plans, including risk mitigation. Reviewing complex project and contract budgets for adequacy, completeness, and other requirements. Identifying and developing solutions to items that may impact project schedule or cost and addressing with responsible parties and analyzing project status, revising the scope, schedule, or budget when necessary to ensure that project requirements can be met. Job Description Key Accountabilities Management and oversight of vendor contracts; acting as the Owner’s Representative. Delivery of projects within cost and schedule constraints involving multiple vendors and coordination of a variety of internal work. Providing a high level of customer service, continuous day-to-day support of peers/groups and proactive involvement with the leadership team, fellow peers and customers. Providing oversight of consultants and contractors to ensure policies/procedures are followed and standards are met, ensuring compliance with specifications and standards. Focusing on continuous improvement and providing leadership on initiatives and projects. Drive project team adherence to pre-outage and outage work management milestones. Demonstrated troubleshooting ability to identify issues, assess alternatives and risks, and implement solutions while keeping overall project on track. Establish and maintain processes for managing scope during the project lifecycle, setting quality and performance standards and assessing risks. Develop and maintain partnerships with third-party resources, including vendors and researchers Assign and monitor resources to ensure project efficiency and maximize deliverables. Report project outcomes and/or risks to the appropriate management channels and escalate issues, as necessary, according to project work plan. Performing Emergency Response Organization (ERO) duties as assigned. Education, Experience, & Skill Requirements High school or secondary school diploma with 8 years’ experience OR a bachelor’s degree or higher with five years’ experience 5-8 years of project management experience, preferably with steam turbine projects, and experience in construction management or the power generation industry are beneficial. Four years’ experience at a commercial nuclear power plant (preferred). PMP or IPMA certification is desired; will be required within 2 years of becoming the Project Manager. A strong understanding of steam turbine design, assembly, repair, and auxiliary systems is necessary. Knowledge of turbine thermodynamics and relevant industry standards is also helpful. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc..) , ERP systems (like SAP or Maximo), and other relevant software is needed. Essential skills include leadership, communication, negotiation, problem-solving, organization, and interpersonal abilities. The ability to multitask and work effectively in a matrix structure is also important. Strong written and oral/verbal communication skills, including the ability to make formal presentations to management. The ability to access all areas of a customer site, including confined spaces and heights, is required. The work environment involves both office and field settings, including power plants. There may be exposure to extreme temperatures, noise, and vibrations. Travel is required to support fleet outages, meetings and project execution/evaluation. Key Metrics Safety Excellence Risk Mitigation and Contingency Planning Continuous Improvement Problem Solving / Decision Making Results Orientation Job Family Plant Operations Company Vistra Nuclear Operations Company Locations Glen Rose, Texas Texas We are a company of people committed to: Exceeding Customer Expectations, Great People, Teamwork, Competitive Spirit and Effective Communication. If this describes you, then apply today! If you currently work for Vistra or its subsidiaries, please apply via the internal career site. It is the policy of the Company to comply with all employment laws and to afford equal employment opportunity to individuals in all aspects of employment, including in selection for job opportunities, without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, military service, protected veteran status, or any other consideration protected by federal, state or local laws. If you are an individual with a disability and need assistance submitting an application or would like to request an accommodation, please email us at assistance@vistraenergy.com to make a request.

title: BI, Analytics & AI Specialist
jd_text: If you have what it takes to become part of the Vistra family and would like to start a promising career with a global leader, take a look at the exciting employment opportunities that are currently available and apply online. Job Summary As a BI, Analytics & AI Specialist, you will partner with cross-functional leaders to uncover, activate, and optimize growth opportunities. You will transform raw energy market and customer data into strategic, automated insights that drive millions in revenue impact while democratizing data access across the organization through natural language querying, self-service dashboards, bespoke analysis, and machine learning. This role will provide expertise in the following areas of the business: • Design and deliver AI-powered interactive dashboards using generative BI capabilities (natural language queries, automated insight generation) and performance reporting that enable real-time decision-making across retail portfolios. • Conduct deep-dive analyses to optimize customer lifecycle value through acquisition analytics, pricing optimization, churn modeling and assessment, customer engagement analytics, and advanced testing and measurement solutions. • Champion adoption of emerging AI/ML tools and methodologies, staying current with generative BI innovations (e.g., AI-assisted data preparation, automated anomaly detection, conversational analytics) to maintain Vistra's analytical competitive edge. • Mentor and develop junior analysts, fostering a culture of continuous learning and analytical excellence. Job Description Key Accountabilities Lead implementation of BI and AI-enhanced initiatives that identify profitable growth opportunities and optimize portfolio performance across Vistra's retail energy and customer markets, directly influencing pricing strategies and customer acquisition and retention initiatives. Own end-to-end BI solution development utilizing Python, SQL, Tableau, Power BI, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, generative BI tools, or other programming languages to build executive dashboards and operational reports that enable stakeholders to make faster, data-driven decisions. Translate complex energy usage, pricing, customer profile and behavior data into clear, actionable recommendations for Pricing, Portfolio Management, Finance, Marketing, and Customer Experience teams and channels. Lead in-depth descriptive, diagnostic, predictive, and prescriptive analysis of portfolio performance and uncover root causes for trends in channel gains, portfolio and customer lifecycle losses, transactional margin performance, portfolio and product mix outcomes, turning findings into automated alerts and strategic action plans. Stay up-to-date with emerging technologies and industry best practices in BI. Lead evaluation and implementation of AI-enhanced BI platforms including generative analytics tools that enable natural language data exploration, automated insight surfacing, and predictive recommendations for business stakeholders. Provide thought leadership and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning, innovation and collaboration. Education, Experience, & Skill Requirements Bachelor's Degree with 5+ years (or Master's with 3+ years, or equivalent 8+ years) of professional experience in data analysis or a related field. Extensive experience in analyzing large volumes of data using Python, SQL, SAS, R or similar programming languages. Experience collaborating with data engineering and data science teams to define requirements, integrate ML model outputs into BI dashboards, and navigate ambiguous business problems. Experience using Power BI or Tableau for data visualization. Exposure to GenBI and the ability to build it from the ground up. Demonstrated expertise building production dashboards in Power BI or Tableau for executives and audience personas across the organization. Exposure to and hands-on experience with generative BI/AI-enhanced analytics tools (e.g. Power BI Copilot, Tableau Pulse, or similar platforms) including natural language query design and automated insight configuration preferred. Web analytics experience with working knowledge of web analytics tools such as Adobe or Google Analytics. Hands-on experience designing and analyzing A/B tests and multivariate experiments to optimize pricing strategies, marketing campaigns, and customer experience initiatives. Solid understanding of financial modeling and investment analysis (ROI, CLV). Strategic thinker who balances analytical rigor with business pragmatism, excelling in cross-functional collaboration with business and technical stakeholders. Familiarity with AI/ML concepts applied to business analytics including predictive modeling, supervised/unsupervised learning, feature engineering, and model interpretation for business stakeholders. Key Metrics Proactively learns business drivers and customer behavior patterns to design high-impact dashboards and analyses that anticipate stakeholder needs. Consistently delivers accurate, high-quality analyses within agreed timelines, maintaining data integrity standards that stakeholders trust for critical decisions. Development of clear, concise, and effective executive-level reporting and presentations. Successfully balances multiple high-priority projects in Vistra's dynamic retail energy environment, maintaining quality standards while adapting to shifting market conditions and business priorities. What We Offer Collaborative culture where your AI-powered analyses drive strategic decisions impacting millions in revenue. Professional development budget for AI/ML and analytics certifications. Access to cutting-edge generative BI and analytics platforms, including but not limited to: BI Tools: Power BI, Tableau, Excel. Generative AI / BI Tools: Power BI Copilot, Tableau Pulse, Copilot, OpenAI Private Instance. Programming: Python, SQL, SAS. Web Analytics: Adobe Analytics. Databases / Platforms: Snowflake, Hana, Iguazio, and more. Collaboration: Working with data engineering, data science, technology and several business functions. Hybrid work flexibility with competitive salary and performance-based bonus opportunities. Clear career progression into more senior roles (e.g. Principal, Manager, and beyond). Comprehensive benefits including $0 premium health plan options, generous HSA contributions, 401(k) with full match on first 6%, fertility/adoption assistance, pet insurance, leading digital health tools, competitive PTO and paid holidays. title: Systems Architect Supervisor (P109)
jd_text: Job Description Summary: Salary: $133,952.00 - $200,928.00 annually The Systems Architect Supervisor is responsible for overseeing the comprehensive enterprise architecture design, development, and deployment of TRWD’s IT systems and infrastructure. This includes managing disaster recovery, cloud infrastructure, server compute and storage, as well as Identity and Access Management (IAM). They ensure that systems meet employee and business requirements while maintaining sustainability, scalability, security, and resilience. Additionally, they evaluate, select, and test technology products critical for solution delivery, and lead the setup, implementation, and documentation of technology integrations or migration strategies. Alongside supervising a small team of Cloud and Systems Engineers, they provide essential technical guidance across the Information Services organization. Job Description Essential Functions and Responsibilities: The duties listed below are intended only as illustrations of the various types of work that may be performed. The omission of specific statements of duties does not exclude them from the position if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment to this position. Responsibilities include: Enterprise Architecture Design and Development : Lead the design and development efforts to architect IT systems that align with organizational objectives and future growth plans. Employ a strategic approach to ensure systems are adaptable, scalable, and capable of meeting evolving business needs. Act as part of the Enterprise Architecture Review Board to ensure technology solutions across all technical stacks are implemented to effectively meet business goals. Technology Evaluation and Selection : Evaluate emerging technologies and tools to determine their suitability for integration into TRWD’s IT infrastructure. Conduct thorough testing and analysis to assess the performance, reliability, and security of potential solutions. Supervision and Team Leadership : Manage and mentor a team of Cloud and Systems Engineers, providing guidance and support to foster their professional growth and development. Coordinate team efforts to achieve project milestones and deliverables effectively. Technical Guidance and Collaboration : Serve as a technical authority within the Information Services organization, offering expertise and insights on complex architectural decisions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to align technology initiatives with business objectives and requirements. Website Portfolio Management : Oversee the hosting and management of TRWD’s portfolio of websites, ensuring optimal performance, reliability, and security. Collaborate with web development teams to implement best practices and leverage innovative solutions for website optimization. Identity and Access Management (IAM) : Implement and maintain robust IAM policies and procedures to safeguard sensitive data and resources. Ensure proper authentication, authorization, and access controls are in place to protect against unauthorized access and data breaches. Cloud Architecture and Services (Microsoft Azure) : Design and implement cloud architecture solutions leveraging Microsoft Azure services. Ensure scalability, reliability, and security of cloud-based infrastructure while optimizing cost and performance. Cost Management : Monitor and optimize infrastructure costs to ensure efficient resource utilization and alignment with budgetary constraints. Implement cost-saving measures and identify opportunities for optimization to maximize ROI. Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity : Develop and maintain disaster recovery and business continuity plans to mitigate the impact of potential disruptions. Implement robust backup and recovery strategies to ensure data integrity and availability in the event of system failures or disasters. Telemetry Management : Oversee the collection, analysis, and interpretation of telemetry data to monitor system performance, identify potential issues, and optimize resource utilization. Utilize telemetry insights to make data-driven decisions and drive continuous improvement efforts around capacity, vulnerability, and performance management. Vulnerability Management : Implement and oversee vulnerability management processes to identify, prioritize, and remediate security vulnerabilities across the IT infrastructure. Collaborate with security teams to implement patches and updates in a timely manner, ensuring the organization remains protected against potential threats. Incident, Problem, and Change Management : Establish and enforce incident, problem, and change management processes for infrastructure components. Ensure timely resolution of incidents and problems while minimizing the impact of changes on operations. Documentation and Knowledge Management : Maintain detailed documentation of architecture designs, integration plans, and technology evaluations. Facilitate knowledge sharing and best practices dissemination to enhance team efficiency and effectiveness. Required Experience: A minimum of ten (10) years progressive experience involving IT systems administration and engineering within a virtualized Windows Server and Azure Cloud environment. Previous supervisory experience involving diverse and highly technical teams. Demonstrated automation and infrastructure as code (IaC) experience (e.g. PowerShell, Ansible, ARM templates, Bicep, Azure CLI). Expertise in implementing and deploying VMWARE ESXi, VMWare Virtual Center and Virtual Desktop Infrastructure, Hyper V, and other enterprise virtualization solutions. Serverless hosting using containerization (Docker, K8, etc.) Experience managing both native Microsoft Azure and hybrid cloud solutions using Azure Arc. Identity and Access Management in hybrid Active Directory/Entra environments. Previous management of enterprise storage solutions such as SAN, NAS, SDS, Azure Storage Accounts Capacity, performance, and security analysis using telemetry repositories such as Elastic or Splunk. Technical documentation of complex IT systems. Advanced knowledge of data security administration principles, method, and techniques including firewalls, network, intrusion detection systems, file integrity monitoring, anomaly detection, and DLP rules. Identify training budget needs Performance review alignment Job description review Maintain familiarity with strategic District levels of service Continuous improvement monitoring and innovation efforts Perform other duties as required Required Education/Certification/License: Bachelor’s degree in a related field of study. An additional five (5) years of work experience in the enterprise technology industry can be used in lieu of degree. Must pass a Texas DPS/FBI Criminal Justice Information Services (CJIS) criminal history background check and maintain CJIS eligibility Valid Texas driver’s license Desired Education/Certification/License: TOGAF, Zachman, or equivalent enterprise architecture certification Microsoft Azure certification ITIL or COBIT certification VMware VCDX, VCAP Success Factors/Job Competencies: Detailed technical documentation skills Adhering to and creating policies and procedures Excellent problem-solving ability and second order strategic thinking Strong attention to detail to diagnose resolve systemic problems Ability to work outside regular working hours as needed by the client, including evenings and weekends Self-motivated, ability to learn new technologies quickly and independently Planning – ability to think ahead and plan over five (5) years Strong team player Physical Demands and Work Environment The physical demands and work environment characteristics described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. Physical demands : While performing duties of job, employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hand to finger, handle, or feel objects, tools, or controls; reach with hands and arms; balance; stoop; talk and hear. Must not be afraid of heights. Must be able to drive necessary distances when required. Employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by the job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus. Work environment: While performing the duties of this job, the employee typically resides within an office or cubicle and may have occasional fieldwork that will expose the employee to weather conditions prevalent at the time.

title: Sales Operations Manager, Direct Sales
jd_text: <p><strong>About OpenSesame</strong></p> <p>OpenSesame is transforming workforce development with an AI-powered marketplace of skill-building courses and learning pathways. We help organizations build skills and stay compliant through a high-quality content catalog, seamless LMS/LXP integrations, and advanced capabilities like skills-based curation and multilingual content creation. More than 2,000 companies, including 150+ of the Global 2000, rely on OpenSesame to develop the world's most productive and admired workforces.<br>Learn more: <a href="http://www.opensesame.com/about" target="_blank">www.opensesame.com/about</a></p> <p><strong>About the Revenue Operations Team</strong></p> <p>The OpenSesame Revenue Operations team is the operational backbone and growth catalyst of the company,&nbsp; enabling our Go-To-Market teams to sell, serve, and scale with clarity and confidence. We design the systems, processes, and insights that turn strategy into execution and ensure revenue flows efficiently from first conversation to renewal.</p> <p>We partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, Partners, Finance, and Legal to remove friction, enforce smart governance, and create a consistent, high-quality customer experience. Our work blends data, process, technology, and judgment to help the business move faster, without cutting corners.</p> <p>What makes our Revenue Operations team unique:</p> <ul> <li>We embrace automation and AI to reduce manual work, surface insights faster, and scale best practices.</li> <li>We invest deeply in operational excellence and continuous improvement, balancing speed with discipline.</li> <li>We are systems thinkers and problem solvers, motivated by making complex processes simpler and more scalable.</li> <li>We measure success by business outcomes: deal velocity, forecast accuracy, won revenue and customer experience.</li> <li>We operate with an owner’s mindset, taking accountability for results, not just activity.</li> <li>We do the right thing, even when it requires tough conversations or slowing down a deal to protect the business.</li> <li>We communicate with clarity and credibility, serving as trusted advisors to GTM teams and leadership.</li> <li>We believe the best results come from tight collaboration and shared learning, supporting one another through peer problem-solving, documentation, and knowledge-sharing so the entire organization gets better together.</li> </ul> <p><strong>About the Sales Operations Manager, Direct Sales role:</strong></p> <p>The Sales Operations Manager, Direct Sales is the operational partner responsible for helping the AE organization generate revenue with greater clarity, discipline, speed, and predictability.</p> <p>This is a manager-level individual contributor role with no direct reports. The role partners closely with Sales leadership, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Finance, Business Systems, SDR, and Marketing to improve how the Direct Sales motion runs from lead and opportunity management through Closed Won.</p> <p>This is not a reporting-only role or a tactical support desk. The right person will diagnose what is slowing sellers down, pressure-test pipeline and forecast assumptions, identify where process or data is breaking down, and lead operational changes that improve sales execution.</p> <p>Success in this role means Sales leaders trust the forecast, managers have clear operating views, sellers understand what good looks like, and the business can see where the pipeline is healthy, where risk exists, and where to focus next.</p> <p><strong>Performance Objectives</strong></p> <p><strong>Establish Clarity and Trust (First 30 Days)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build a deep understanding of the Direct Sales motion, including lead flow, opportunity management, pipeline creation, forecast cadence, sales stages, handoffs, and performance drivers.</li> <li>Establish strong relationships with Sales leadership, frontline managers, SDR Ops, Enablement, Finance, Marketing, Business Systems, and Analytics.</li> <li>Audit lead and opportunity management processes to identify gaps in adoption, stage integrity, forecast visibility, seller efficiency, and manager accountability.</li> <li>Assess pipeline health, CRM hygiene, forecast accuracy, close-date discipline, territory design, quota coverage, and seller tool adoption.</li> <li>Identify the highest-impact opportunities to reduce seller friction through process simplification, automation, AI-enabled workflows, or better reporting.</li> <li>Deliver a current-state assessment with prioritized recommendations, including quick wins and longer-term improvements.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Build Operational Rigor (60 Days)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Refine lead and opportunity workflows to improve pipeline quality, accountability, and forecast reliability.</li> <li>Implement pipeline hygiene standards, including stage criteria, aging thresholds, next-step expectations, close-date discipline, and forecast category guidance.</li> <li>Establish a consistent pipeline inspection and forecasting cadence with Sales leadership and frontline managers.</li> <li>Build manager-owned operating rhythms so Sales Ops enables accountability without becoming the long-term owner of seller follow-up.</li> <li>Deliver actionable insights on funnel conversion, sales velocity, win rates, stage progression, deal quality, and rep/segment performance.</li> <li>Scope automation or AI-enabled opportunities that reduce manual work, improve data quality, or surface risk faster.</li> <li>Partner with Business Systems and Enablement to support CRM/workflow improvements, rollout readiness, seller communication, and adoption.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Scale Predictability and Impact (90+ Days)</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own ongoing pipeline health, stage integrity, forecast inspection, and adoption standards across the Direct Sales motion.</li> <li>Improve forecast confidence by identifying risk early and surfacing root causes tied to process, coverage, deal quality, seller behavior, or market dynamics.</li> <li>Establish durable reporting and inspection views for sellers, managers, Sales leadership, Finance, and RevOps.</li> <li>Assess territory, quota, capacity, and account coverage models; provide recommendations aligned to growth plans.</li> <li>Surface repeatable insights on ICP fit, account prioritization, deal quality, source performance, and conversion drivers.</li> <li>Build feedback loops with Marketing, SDR Ops, Partners, Product, Enablement, and CS based on field data and funnel performance.</li> <li>Drive measurable improvements in tool adoption, seller efficiency, sales cycle visibility, pipeline quality, and forecast accuracy.</li> <li>Be viewed by Sales leadership as a trusted operating partner who brings clarity, urgency, and practical solutions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Ongoing Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Pipeline, Forecasting &amp; Deal Inspection</strong></p> <ul> <li>Own pipeline health, stage integrity, and inspection frameworks across the Direct Sales motion.</li> <li>Lead or support weekly forecasting cadence with Sales leadership and frontline managers.</li> <li>Pressure-test forecast assumptions using stage progression, deal aging, close-date movement, next steps, source quality, ICP fit, and historical conversion.</li> <li>Identify forecast risk early and surface root causes tied to process, coverage, deal quality, seller behavior, or market dynamics.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Sales Process, Tool Adoption &amp; Change Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Diagnose seller friction across CRM workflows, sales tools, lead/opportunity processes, and handoffs.</li> <li>Build scalable processes that improve seller productivity without creating unnecessary administrative burden.</li> <li>Drive adoption of core sales tools and processes through stakeholder alignment, enablement, manager reinforcement, and adoption tracking.</li> <li>Partner with Enablement to create clear, practical training and reinforcement materials.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Automation, AI &amp; Seller Efficiency</strong></p> <ul> <li>Identify opportunities to use automation and AI-enabled workflows to reduce manual work, improve data quality, and surface insights faster.</li> <li>Partner with Business Systems, Analytics, and Enablement to scope, test, and roll out workflows that improve seller and manager productivity.</li> <li>Explore use cases such as CRM update support, call/note summarization, pipeline risk detection, qualification validation, account prioritization, manager inspection summaries, executive forecast summaries, and seller prep automation.</li> <li>Measure whether automation and AI-enabled workflows improve adoption, efficiency, pipeline quality, forecast confidence, or sales cycle performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Territory, Quota, Capacity &amp; Account Strategy</strong></p> <ul> <li>Design, maintain, and recommend improvements to territory and account assignment models.</li> <li>Partner with Sales leadership, Finance, Analytics, and SDR Ops on quota modeling, capacity planning, and coverage analysis.</li> <li>Evaluate account potential, whitespace, greenspace, ICP fit, historical performance, pipeline coverage, rep capacity, and segment dynamics.</li> <li>Support quarterly and annual planning through scenario modeling and data-backed recommendations.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Performance &amp; Funnel Analytics</strong></p> <ul> <li>Analyze sales cycle, conversion rates, win rates, velocity, source performance, and deal quality by segment, source, territory, and rep cohort.</li> <li>Diagnose performance gaps rooted in process, ICP fit, coverage, source quality, handoff quality, or deal execution patterns.</li> <li>Translate complex data into clear recommendations for Sales leadership and cross-functional partners.</li> <li>Build executive-ready narratives that explain what happened, why it happened, what is at risk, and what action should be taken.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Business Systems Partnership</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serve as the business owner for Direct Sales process requirements while partnering with Business Systems on technical configuration and implementation.</li> <li>Translate field needs into clear business requirements.</li> <li>Support UAT, rollout readiness, seller communication, and post-launch adoption tracking.</li> <li>Ensure systems changes are practical, scalable, and aligned to how sellers and managers actually work.</li> </ul> <p>You might notice we don’t have the typical list of requirements and buzzwords here. That’s intentional.</p> <p>We’re looking for proven examples from your career that show you can do this job — that you’ve built systems, driven alignment, and created impact at scale. title: Manager (M4)
jd_text: Who We Are Applied Materials is the global leader in materials science and engineering solutions that are at the foundation of virtually every new semiconductor chip and advanced display in the world. The equipment that we create and service is essential to advancing AI and accelerating the commercialization of next-generation semiconductor chips. Join us and push the boundaries of materials science and engineering in a company at the foundation of the electronics industry. The work we do together advances the world’s technology. What We Offer Salary: $120,000.00 - $165,000.00 Location: Austin,TX You’ll benefit from a supportive work culture that encourages you to learn, develop, and grow your career as you take on challenges and drive innovative solutions for our customers. We empower our team to push the boundaries of what is possible—while learning every day in a supportive leading global company. Visit our Careers website to learn more. At Applied Materials, we care about the health and wellbeing of our employees. We’re committed to providing programs and support that encourage personal and professional growth and care for you at work, at home, or wherever you may go. Learn more about our benefits . Key Responsibilities Develop, implement and manage cross-functional, fully integrated planning process that incorporates make versus buy, capacity planning, scheduling, inventory, material and associated cost elements. Performs analysis of customer demand, sales forecasts and historical material usage to develop and execute build to order and build to forecast plans.  Coordinate with cross-functional business teams to develop best cost strategy for production planning to support customer demand. Establish and implement methods and best practices related to the systems and process that support inventory forecasting, purchasing, and material control. Establishes and manages production scheduling activities by monitoring material inventories, tracking progress of production and reviewing factors that affect schedules.  Responsible for accuracy of inventory counts by implementing and managing, in conjunction with Finance, and inventory control system, capable of identifying discrepancies in inventory counts and taking corrective action to guard against inconsistencies in the future. Develop and execute a sourcing strategy to meet the company's business growth and sourcing requirements.  Identify, develop, and manage effective relationship with existing and potential suppliers of goods and services to meet the established cost, quality and delivery targets. Establish, implement, and manage system to evaluate, monitor and report supplier scorecard performance. Coordinate and work with quality, engineering, machining, and assembly operations to ensure 100% on-time delivery by establishing and monitoring schedule to proactively identify and address any issues. Represents materials organization on corporate materials task force teams.  Manages department budget, associated costs and resources. Functional Knowledge Demonstrates in-depth understanding of concepts, theories and principles in own job family and basic knowledge of other related job families Business Expertise Applies understanding of the industry and how own area contributes to the achievement of objectives Leadership Manages a generally homogeneous team; adapts plans and priorities to meet service and/or operational challenges Problem Solving Identifies and resolves technical, operational and organizational problems  Impact Impacts the level of service and the team’s ability to meet quality, volume, and timeliness objectives Guided by policies and resource requirements within business unit, department or sub-function Interpersonal Skills Guides, influences and persuades others internally in related areas or externally Position requires understanding of Applied Materials global Standards of Business Conduct and compliance with these standards at all times. This includes demonstrating the highest level of ethical conduct reflecting Applied Materials' core values. Additional Information Time Type: Full time Employee Type: Assignee / Regular Travel: Yes, 10% of the Time Relocation Eligible: No The salary offered to a selected candidate will be based on multiple factors including location, hire grade, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and with consideration of internal equity of our current team members. In addition to a comprehensive benefits package, candidates may be eligible for other forms of compensation such as participation in a bonus and a stock award program, as applicable. For all sales roles, the posted salary range is the Target Total Cash (TTC) range for the role, which is the sum of base salary and target bonus amount at 100% goal achievement. Applied Materials is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, citizenship, ancestry, religion, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, veteran or military status, or any other basis prohibited by law. In addition, Applied endeavors to make our careers site accessible to all users. If you would like to contact us regarding accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us via e-mail at Accommodations_Program@amat.com, or by calling our HR Direct Help Line at 877-612-7547, option 1, and following the prompts to speak to an HR Advisor. This contact is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications.

title: Production Supervisor Pork 2nd Shift
location: Sherman Case Rdy Plant - Sherman, Texas
jd_text: Job Details: SUMMARY: This position is responsible for maintaining high production, quality, and yields while ensuring the safest working environment possible. This position requires an essential understanding and control of the production process, accurate record keeping, and general line maintenance and staffing. RESPONSIBILITIES: Checking daily production orders to ensure fulfillment of customer orders Ensuring every position is filled before start-up of production line Overseeing Team Member morning exercises and job rotation to facilitate ergonomics Ensuring all machinery is performing to the highest standard possible. Ensuring all workstations have passed USDA Inspection Promoting safety daily as well as through monthly safety meetings Ensuring accurate shipments, rotation of inventory, and proper coding of products. Additionally, knowing and communicating company benefits and compensation policies to Team Members Providing encouragement to Team Members to build the best team possible Critical ability to perform the human relations functions such as training Retaining, and counseling on personal and professional problems. Overseeing various processing operations and working with other supervisors in solving problems Keeping records of reworked or returned product Providing continuous education on the importance of quality Performing other responsibilities as the need arises REQUIREMENTS: Experience: 2 years in a manufacturing environment and prior supervisory experience preferred. Education: High school diploma; education beyond high school including special training, vocational school and/or college courses is preferred. Computer Skills: Basic computer skills helpful. Communication Skills: Strong communication skills. Supervisory: This position is responsible for supervising a group of personnel who perform somewhat identical and related tasks or activities. Travel: 1-5 trips per year. Must submit resume for consideration. This position is slated for candidates who are currently working at this facility and displaced team members. Priority consideration will be provided to these applicants first. If local Team Members are not selected, external candidates will then be reviewed for consideration. All professional team members are expected to demonstrate responsible use of approved AI tools, including safeguarding sensitive information, adhering to company policies, and validating AI-generated outputs. title: Technical Customer Success Manager - Conversational AI Or Agentic AI
jd_text: <div class="content-intro"><p>At NiCE, we don’t limit our challenges. We challenge our limits. Always. We’re ambitious. We’re game changers. And we play to win. We set the highest standards and execute beyond them. And if you’re like us, we can offer you the ultimate career opportunity that will light a fire within you.</p></div><p><strong>So, what’s the role all about?</strong></p> <p>We are looking for a Technical Customer Success Specialist to support our Customer Success Managers (CSMs) by providing deep technical&nbsp;expertise&nbsp;across a portfolio of enterprise customers. This role is designed to scale technical knowledge across the Customer Success organization and act as a technical backbone for day-to-day account engagement.&nbsp;</p> <p>You will work in a one-to-many model, partnering with multiple CSMs and supporting&nbsp;approximately 30–50 customer accounts. Your focus will be on answering technical questions,&nbsp;advising on&nbsp;best practices, and helping customers successfully design,&nbsp;operate, and&nbsp;optimize&nbsp;conversational AI solutions built on the&nbsp;Cognigy&nbsp;platform.&nbsp;</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of Customer Success, Product, and Conversational AI&nbsp;expertise.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>How will you make an impact?</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>Act as a shared technical resource for CSMs across multiple enterprise accounts&nbsp;</li> <li>Support CSMs with technical topics related to platform usage, solution design, product functionality,&nbsp;demos&nbsp;and best practice&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide&nbsp;timely&nbsp;responses to technical questions from CSMs and, where&nbsp;appropriate, directly from customers&nbsp;</li> <li>Serve as an escalation point for complex “how does this work” or “how should we do this” questions&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Conversational AI &amp; Platform Expertise&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Advise customers on conversational AI best practices, including dialog design, intent modeling, and flow orchestration&nbsp;</li> <li>Support NLU configuration, training, testing, and optimization&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide guidance on the application of generative AI and agentic AI concepts within enterprise conversational solutions&nbsp;</li> <li>Help customers understand platform capabilities, limitations, and recommended patterns&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Contact Center &amp; Enterprise Context&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Support customers&nbsp;operating&nbsp;conversational AI solutions within contact center environments (voice and digital)&nbsp;</li> <li>Provide&nbsp;high-level guidance on integrations with&nbsp;CCaaS, CRM, and backend systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Help customers troubleshoot issues related to conversation behavior, routing, and experience design&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Collaboration &amp; Feedback Loop&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Collaborate closely with Support, Product, Engineering, and Professional Services to resolve customer issues&nbsp;</li> <li>Identify&nbsp;recurring themes, gaps, or improvement opportunities and feed insights back to internal teams&nbsp;</li> <li>Contribute to internal documentation, enablement materials, and best-practice guides for CSMs&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Scale &amp; Efficiency&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Help standardize technical guidance across the customer base&nbsp;</li> <li>Enable CSMs to handle more technical conversations independently over time&nbsp;</li> <li>Improve internal processes and documentation to support a growing enterprise customer footprint&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>Have you got what it takes?</strong><strong> </strong></p> <ul> <li>3–5 years of experience in conversational AI, virtual agents, or intelligent automation&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience in a customer-facing technical role (Customer Success, Solution Consulting, Technical Support, or Professional Services)&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience supporting enterprise customers in a one-to-many or scaled model&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Technical Expertise&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Strong understanding of conversational AI fundamentals, including:&nbsp;</li> <li>NLU concepts (intents, entities, training data, evaluation)&nbsp;</li> <li>Generative AI and LLM-based conversational systems&nbsp;</li> <li>Agentic AI and multi-step orchestration patterns&nbsp;</li> <li>Solid understanding of contact center operations and customer service workflows&nbsp;</li> <li>Ability to analyze conversational behavior and explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong><u>Personal Attributes&nbsp;</u></strong></p> <ul> <li>Structured, organized, and comfortable juggling multiple customers and priorities&nbsp;</li> <li>Clear communicator with a pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset&nbsp;</li> <li>Curious and eager to stay current with advancements in conversational and generative AI&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong sense&nbsp;of ownership and customer focus&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>You will have an advantage if you also have:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Hands-on experience with enterprise conversational AI platforms&nbsp;</li> </ul> <ul> <li>Familiarity with&nbsp;Cognigy&nbsp;or&nbsp;similar products&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience working with voice automation and&nbsp;CCaaS&nbsp;integrations&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p><strong>About </strong><strong>Cognigy</strong></p> <p>NiCE Cognigy delivers AI that works—fast, human, and enterprise-ready. As the leading AI-first CX platform built for real-world scale, we combine Generative and Conversational AI through orchestration, tools, and enterprise systems to power Agentic AI. Backed by global CX leader NiCE, we empower brands with AI Agents that redefine customer experiences and achieve measurable ROI—instantly, across every channel and in 100+ languages.</p> <p><strong>Requisition ID: </strong>10131<strong><br>Reporting into: </strong>Team Lead, CSM<br><strong>Role Type: </strong>Individual Contributor</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><em><strong>About NiCE </strong></em></p> <p><em>NICE Ltd. (NASDAQ: NICE) software products are used by 25,000+ global businesses, including 85 of the Fortune 100 corporations, to deliver extraordinary customer experiences, fight financial crime and ensure public safety. Every day, NiCE software manages more than 120 million customer interactions and monitors 3+ billion financial transactions. </em></p> <p><em>Known as an innovation powerhouse that excels in AI, cloud and digital, NiCE is consistently recognized as the market leader in its domains, with over 8,500 employees across 30+ countries. </em></p> <p><em>NiCE is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, neurotype, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other category protected by law.</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p></div>

title: Field Marketing Manager - Detroit (Remote)
jd_text: <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">Who You Are</span></strong></p> <p>You are a strategic, highly organized marketing professional who thrives on creating exceptional experiences that strengthen relationships, elevate brand awareness, and drive business growth. You combine creativity with operational excellence, bringing structure, attention to detail, and thoughtful planning to every initiative.</p> <p>You are equally comfortable developing marketing strategy, managing event logistics, collaborating with cross-functional teams, and analyzing results to continuously improve performance. You communicate clearly, proactively solve problems, and build trusted relationships with sales teams, technology partners, and internal stakeholders.</p> <p>You thrive in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift quickly, and you take pride in delivering high-quality programs that reflect Myriad360's commitment to excellence.</p> <p><strong><span data-contrast="auto">About The Role</span></strong></p> <p>As the Field Marketing Manager – Central Region, you will lead Myriad360's regional marketing strategy and execution across the Midwest, Great Lakes, and Ohio Valley. initiatives, and customer engagement programs while supporting select national marketing initiatives.</p> <p>This role directly impacts pipeline generation, partner engagement, customer relationships,
