title: Director, Customer Journey Activation Product Manager
jd_text: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa’s Customer Journey Business Product team is a cross-functional organization responsible for driving product strategy and execution across the end-to-end customer journey from demand generation through sales, implementation, servicing, and growth. Our team operates as a true enterprise product organization, partnering closely with Sales, Customer Success, Implementation, Operations, Finance, Support, and Technology to design and scale capabilities that work consistently across Visa. Product leaders on this team own outcomes across the lifecycle, not just individual tools, and play a critical role in shaping how work scales across regions, value streams, and customer motions. We are seeking a Director, Implementation & Activation Product Management to lead the product strategy for the post-sales customer experience, with a focus on implementation, onboarding, activation, and transition to ongoing customer success. This role will serve as the connective point between the seller and Customer Success teams, bringing together the systems, workflows, data, and governance needed to create a more seamless and connected post-sales journey. The leader in this role will be critical to driving revenue outcomes by improving time-to-value, activation, adoption, implementation efficiency, and visibility into post-sale performance. Key Responsibilities: Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Implementation / Activation value stream across the sales to post-sales customer journey. Design and scale a connected implementation and activation experience from deal through onboarding, go-live, early usage, and handoff to Customer Success. Bridge Sales, CS, Implementation, Finance, and Technology teams to align process, roles, systems, and customer milestones. Define the business architecture and workflow model that connects seller commitments, implementation readiness, customer onboarding steps, activation milestones, and ongoing success management. Drive platform and process improvements across CRM, onboarding, implementation, workflow, case management, customer communications, and reporting tools to reduce friction in the post-sale journey. Partner operations and customer-facing leaders to ensure implementation and activation motions support revenue targets, forecast accuracy, customer retention, and expansion readiness. Establish and monitor OKRs such as implementation cycle time, time-to-value, activation rate, onboarding completion, feature adoption, customer satisfaction, and post-sale revenue realization. Translate customer, seller, and operational pain points into prioritized product requirements, business cases, and delivery plans. Lead cross-functional governance for post-sales process standardization, while balancing enterprise consistency with regional and segment needs. Drive change management, field enablement, and adoption for new implementation and activation capabilities, workflows, and operating models. Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications: 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 10 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters/MBA /JD/MD), or a minimum of 5 years of work experience with a PhD Preferred Qualifications: 15 or more years of experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 12 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, or MD), PhD with 9+ years of experience 8+ years of experience in product management, revenue operations, customer success operations, implementation, or related enterprise workflow roles. Proven experience working across post-sales journeys, including onboarding, implementation, activation, customer handoff, or service delivery. Experience building or scaling operational processes and product capabilities that improve time-to-value, adoption, and customer outcomes. Strong understanding of how post-sales execution connects to revenue realization, retention, and long-term customer growth. Demonstrated ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders across Sales, Customer Success, Operations, Support, Finance, and Technology. Experience with enterprise platforms such as CRM, workflow, case management, customer success, implementation, or analytics tools. Key Skills: Strong strategic thinking with the ability to connect customer experience, operating processes, and revenue outcomes. Deep understanding of implementation, onboarding, activation, and customer transition workflows. Strong analytical and operational skills, with the ability to turn data into actions and investment priorities. Product leadership mindset with experience defining roadmaps, prioritizing across stakeholders, and driving adoption at scale. Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management skills in complex, matrixed environments. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $174,400.00 to $ 279,100.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. Visa is an EEO Employer Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protect veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

title: Project Manager, Senior Living (CapEx)
jd_text: Job Description: Ventas is a leading S&P 500 company enabling exceptional environments that benefit a large and growing aging population. With an enterprise value exceeding $50 billion and a portfolio of more than 1,400 properties across North America and the United Kingdom, Ventas is a preeminent participant in the longevity economy. Its largest business is private-pay senior housing, which includes over 850 communities providing valuable care and services to more than 90,000 residents. The Ventas portfolio also includes outpatient medical buildings, research centers and healthcare facilities that attract strong institutional demand from the largest health systems, biomedical companies and universities and other research institutions in the world. Backed by strong financial performance and a collaborative culture, Ventas has the capital, capabilities and relationships to deliver superior value. The experienced Ventas team shares a commitment to each other and to the Company’s mission of helping people live longer, healthier, happier lives. The Senior Living CapEx team manages capital investment initiatives across Ventas' senior housing portfolio, helping ensure communities remain competitive, well-positioned, and responsive to resident needs. The team partners closely with operators, asset management, investments, and finance teams to evaluate opportunities, prioritize projects, and measure the impact of capital investments on property performance and long-term value creation. Through a combination of financial analysis, strategic planning, and project oversight, the team plays a key role in supporting the continued growth and success of Ventas' senior housing portfolio. About the Role The Project Manager, Senior Living (CapEx) is responsible for the ongoing management of construction projects across our portfolio. The Project Manager will work closely with the Director, Senior Living (CapEx) to ensure the execution of capital projects in support of Ventas’ long-term capital investment strategy. Key responsibilities include: Work closely with designers, project managers, and contractors to solicit proposals, evaluate them, and make recommendations for selection Manage the execution process and coordinate stakeholders (operator, designer, consultants) on large investment front of house and back of the house projects Work closely with CapEx consultants to manage accuracy of project timing and spend Run weekly or bi-weekly internal update calls Attend weekly Owner, Architect, Designer calls across all larger investment projects Identify general contractors, prepare bid forms, solicit bids, prepare comparisons, and recommend selections Visit job sites weekly, when feasible, depending on project scope and status Work with team to create investment strategy for new acquisitions and NNN transitions Coordinate and communicate with design and construction teams Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in engineering, real estate, or a related field 5+ years of experience in project management in real estate, construction, or development Ability to travel frequently in support of capital projects across the U.S. and Canada, averaging 2–3 overnight stays per week Experience working with an owner/developer, general contractor, or a related entity—preferably in the healthcare industry Familiarity with senior housing, hospitals, nursing facilities, and congregate care is preferred Strong analytical skills and independent decision-making ability Ability to manage deadlines, multiple tasks, and shifting priorities in a fast-paced, lean environment Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without need for employer sponsorship now or in the future The estimated base salary range for this position is $135,000 - 185,000 per year. This range reflects a good-faith estimate of the base salary Ventas reasonably expects to pay at the time of posting. Actual base pay will be determined based on work location, skills, qualifications, relevant experience, and business needs. In addition to base salary, this role is eligible for discretionary incentive compensation and a comprehensive benefits package, which includes medical, dental, vision, retirement savings, paid time off, and other wellness benefits under applicable plan terms. #LI-MB1

title: Director, Procurement Intelligence & Predictive Analytics, Global
jd_text: About Vantage Vantage powers, cools, protects and connects the technology of the world’s well-known hyperscalers, cloud providers and large enterprises. Developing and operating across North America, EMEA and Asia Pacific, Vantage has evolved data center design in innovative ways to deliver dramatic gains in reliability, efficiency and sustainability in flexible environments that can scale as quickly as the market demands. Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance Department The Global Procurement & Supply Chain Governance team supports procurement, source-to-pay processes, supply chain performance, supplier management, working capital visibility, and enterprise decision-making. The team partners closely with Finance, Operations, IT/Data, and procurement stakeholders to improve data quality, build trusted analytics, and translate business needs into measurable operational improvements. Position Overview This role is based remotely in the United States. Vantage is seeking a Director, Procurement Intelligence & Predictive Analytics, Global to lead the strategy, development, and adoption of advanced analytics capabilities across Procurement, Supply Chain, and Finance. This role will drive enterprise-wide data-driven decision making by transforming complex global data into actionable insights that improve operational performance, optimize working capital, mitigate risk, enhance supplier outcomes, and support executive and strategic business decisions. The Director will define and execute the global roadmap for procurement analytics, predictive and prescriptive modeling, machine learning, and decision intelligence solutions across Demand-to-Delivery, Source-to-Pay, supplier performance, spend analytics, inventory and asset management, and cash flow forecasting. Working closely with senior leaders across Procurement, Finance and Technology and Business Functions, this role establishes scalable analytics capabilities, data governance standards, and reporting frameworks that enable informed decision-making and deliver measurable business value worldwide. Essential Job Functions Own and lead the global strategy, roadmap, and governance for procurement analytics, data science, and decision intelligence capabilities that enhance procurement performance, supplier management, sourcing effectiveness, contract compliance, and spend optimization. Serve as a strategic advisor to Procurement, Finance, Technology and executive leadership by translating complex procurement, supplier, inventory, and supply chain data into actionable insights, business strategies, and measurable outcomes. Lead the design and deployment of predictive and prescriptive analytics capabilities, leveraging machine learning, statistical modeling, optimization, forecasting, and decision intelligence to drive enterprise value using both internal and external data sources. Oversee the development and implementation of analytical models supporting demand forecasting, supplier risk management, capacity planning, inventory optimization, lead-time prediction, anomaly detection, and cash flow forecasting. Establish and champion executive dashboards, supplier scorecards, KPI frameworks, and reporting standards that provide visibility into procurement, supply chain, fulfillment, and project performance across the organization. Drive enterprise-wide working capital and cash flow optimization initiatives through advanced analytics of purchasing activity, payment timing, inventory investments, accruals, supplier terms, and capital project spending. Partner with senior leaders across Finance, Procurement, Operations, Technology, and business functions to improve forecasting accuracy, scenario planning, capital allocation, operational efficiency, and supplier performance. Lead transformation initiatives across Source-to-Pay processes by identifying strategic opportunities for automation, compliance improvement, process optimization, and operational excellence. Advance procurement analytics capabilities that increase guided buying adoption, spend visibility, purchase order compliance, invoice matching accuracy, goods receipt management, and overall procurement effectiveness. Establish and maintain global procurement data governance standards, including data quality frameworks, master data management, metadata, lineage, controls, and stewardship practices. Drive a culture of data-driven decision making by promoting analytics adoption, enhancing self-service capabilities, and ensuring analytical insights are embedded into business operations and strategic planning. Influence enterprise data and analytics strategy through collaboration with technology and data teams, ensuring scalable solutions, strong governance, and sustainable business impact. Mentor and develop analytics talent while fostering best practices, innovation, and continuous improvement across the analytics organization. Additional duties as assigned by Management. Job Requirements Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Mathematics, Supply Chain, Finance, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field; advanced degree (MS, MBA, or equivalent) preferred. 10+ years of experience in data science, advanced analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, quantitative strategy, or a related discipline, including experience leading enterprise-scale analytics initiatives. 5+ years of experience supporting or partnering with Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, Operations, or other enterprise business functions, with demonstrated influence at the leadership level. Proven experience developing and executing analytics strategies, roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable business outcomes and organizational transformation. Demonstrated ability to influence executive stakeholders and translate complex analytical insights into strategic recommendations, business decisions, and investment priorities. Deep expertise in advanced analytics, machine learning, statistical modeling, forecasting, optimization, and modern cloud data platforms such as Azure Synapse, Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, or similar technologies. Experience leading the development of enterprise reporting, KPI frameworks, executive dashboards, and self-service analytics capabilities using Power BI, Tableau, or similar technologies. Strong understanding of procurement operations, strategic sourcing, supplier management, spend analytics, working capital optimization, Demand to Delivery, Source-to-Pay, Asset & Inventory, and supply chain performance management. Familiarity with procurement and ERP platforms such as Coupa, SAP Ariba, Oracle, Workday, Yardi, SAP ERP, or similar enterprise systems. Expertise in data governance, master data management, data quality, metadata management, lineage, stewardship, and enterprise data management best practices. Experience integrating and leveraging procurement, finance, supplier, inventory, contract, project, ERP, and payment data to drive strategic insights and operational improvements. Preferred experience in data center infrastructure, construction, capital projects, procurement analytics, finance analytics, supply chain analytics, or other CAPEX-intensive environments. Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams, large-scale transformation initiatives, and enterprise data programs in complex, high-growth organizations. Experience building, mentoring, and developing analytics, business intelligence, or data science talent preferred. Professional certifications such as CDMP, CPSM, CIPS, PMP, or related credentials are preferred. Travel up to 20%, with flexibility to increase as business needs evolve. Physical Demands and Special Requirements The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is occasionally required to stand; walk; sit; use hands to handle, or feel objects; reach with hands and arms; climb stairs; balance; stoop or kneel; talk and hear. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 25 pounds. Additional Details Salary Range: $180,000-200,000 Base + Bonus (this range is based on Colorado market data and may vary in other locations) This position is eligible for company benefits including but not limited to medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and AD&D, short and long-term disability coverage, paid time off, employee assistance, participation in a 401k program that includes company match, and many other additional voluntary benefits. Compensation for the role will depend on a number of factors, including your qualifications, skills, competencies, and experience and may fall outside of the range shown. #LI-Remote #LI-CD1 We operate with No Ego and No Arrogance. We work to build each other up and support one another, appreciating each other’s strengths and respecting each other’s weaknesses. We find joy in our work and each other, actively seeking opportunities to inject fun into what we do. Our hard and efficient work is rewarded with an above market total compensation package. We offer a comprehensive suite of health and welfare, retirement, and paid leave benefits exceeding local expectations. Throughout the year, the advantage of being part of the Vantage team is evident with an array of benefits, recognition, training and development, and the knowledge that your contribution adds value to the company and our community. Don't meet all the requirements? Please still apply if you think you are the right person for the position. We are always keen to speak to people who connect with our mission and values. Vantage is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Vantage does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firm agencies. Fees will not be paid in the event a candidate submitted by a recruiter without an agreement in place is hired; such resumes will be deemed the sole property of Vantage. We’ll be accepting applications for at least one week from the date this role is posted. If you're interested, we encourage you to apply soon—we’re excited to find the right person and will keep the role open until we do!

title: Director, Digital Marketing, Operations & Analytics
jd_text: We’re Watts. Together, we’re reimagining the future of water. We feel proud every day about what we do. We're all part of the same crucial mission, no matter what function we support -- it's to provide safe, clean water for the world, and to protect our planet's most valuable resource. What we do: For 150 years, Watts has built best-in-class products that are trusted by customers in residential and commercial settings across the world. We are at the forefront of innovation, working with cutting-edge technology to provide smart and connected, sustainable water solutions for the future. Watts is a leading brand with a quality reputation — and we have a dynamic future ahead.​ Scope of Position The Director, Digital Marketing, Operations & Analytics is a senior, business-oriented digital marketing leader responsible for defining and scaling the digital experience, marketing technology, analytics and marketing operations capabilities that strengthen customer engagement, demand creation and commercial performance across the Americas. This role leads a shared-services Center of Excellence that partners with regional marketing, product marketing, sales, customer experience, IT and commercial teams to improve the end-to-end customer journey, modernize digital platforms, increase discoverability, enable ecommerce and digital marketing channel growth, and translate data into actionable business insight. The leader is expected to build high-performing teams, establish clear governance, advance AI-enabled ways of working and ensure Watts’ digital experience reflects the quality, reliability and innovation of the brand. This position is responsible for the leadership and development of digital marketing experience, analytics, CRM, marketing operations and related team members. This position reports to the Vice President of Marketing. This role can be remote within the United States with up to 30% travel. Primary Job Duties and Responsibilities Develop and execute the multi-year strategy and operating roadmap for digital experience, marketing operations, CRM, analytics, marketing technology, AI-enabled capability building and digital channel enablement across the Americas. Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team responsible for website operations, user experience, content enablement, SEO/SEM, analytics, CRM, marketing automation, project delivery and marketing technology platforms. Own the strategy for Watts digital properties, including customer journey design, user experience, search discoverability, conversion optimization, personalization, accessibility and site performance. Advance ecommerce and digital channel growth by partnering with sales, channel, product and commercial teams to improve product content, digital merchandising, lead capture, customer acquisition and engagement. Oversee marketing technology architecture, CRM integration, marketing automation, lead management processes, data governance standards and vendor performance. Build executive-level dashboards, attribution models and reporting structures that connect digital engagement, campaign performance, pipeline influence, customer behavior and marketing investment to business results. Establish scalable operating models, governance frameworks, service level expectations and intake/prioritization processes that enable consistent support for stakeholders across brands, regions and functions. Drive AI and automation adoption to improve productivity, speed to market, campaign effectiveness, content creation, insight generation and customer engagement. Serve as a strategic partner to regional and global stakeholders, translating commercial priorities into digital capabilities, measurable initiatives and clear execution plans. Manage agency, consulting and technology partnerships, including scopes of work, budgets, performance expectations and continuous improvement opportunities. Champion Watts values of Integrity, Accountability, Continuous Improvement, Innovation and Transparency through leadership actions, team development and cross-functional collaboration. Assume responsibility for other projects and duties assigned by the Vice President, Marketing - Americas. Travel Requirements: Up to 30% domestic and international travel. Required Qualifications Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, Analytics, Information Systems or related field; equivalent experience considered. 12+ years of progressive leadership experience in digital marketing, digital experience, ecommerce, marketing operations, analytics, CRM, marketing technology or customer experience. 5+ years of people leadership experience, including leading managers, developing talent and building high-performing cross-functional teams. Proven experience building or transforming a digital marketing, ecommerce, customer experience or marketing operations function in a complex, multi-brand or matrixed environment. Demonstrated ownership of website strategy, user experience, customer journey optimization, SEO/SEM, digital campaign performance and conversion improvement. Hands-on leadership experience with CRM, marketing automation, analytics platforms, web content management systems, data governance practices and marketing technology/vendor ecosystems. Strong ability to connect digital activity to business outcomes through dashboards, attribution, financial analysis, executive reporting and actionable insights. Executive communication, change leadership, stakeholder management and cross-functional partnership skills, with the ability to influence sales, marketing, product, IT, finance and operations leaders. Understanding of and adherence to applicable laws, codes, policies, regulations, and safety practices and procedures, as applicable. Must successfully establish employment eligibility and satisfactorily complete background checks and required pre-employment testing as a condition of employment. Preferred Qualifications Experience in the building products, manufacturing, industrial, commercial construction or durable goods sectors. Experience leading a Digital Marketing or Digital Experience Center of Excellence supporting multiple brands, business units or regions. Experience supporting ecommerce growth, digital merchandising, product information management, distributor/channel enablement or marketplace optimization. Advanced understanding of customer journey mapping, content strategy, personalization, web analytics, SEO/SEM and marketing performance optimization. Experience using AI, automation and modern marketing technologies to improve productivity, decision making and customer engagement. MBA or advanced degree in business, marketing, analytics, technology or a related discipline. General Applicable Company Competencies Commitment to Watts’ values of integrity, accountability, continuous improvement and innovation, and transparency. Punctuality and dependability. Ability to be flexible and adapt to changing work priorities and stressful conditions. Adherence to all personnel policies, procedures, and standards of process as implemented by Watts. Maintain productive and collaborative relationships with other Watts employees. Adherence to Watts’ seven cultural beliefs: Growth Mindset, Customer-Focused Innovation, Constant Communication, Clear Goals, Collaborate Globally, Be Inclusive, and Take Action. Working Conditions While performing the job duties, you will be working remotely in an office environment. You may be required to occasionally travel to and work in the office at any Watts Water location for meetings, trainings, or as otherwise required by Company management. Physical Requirements : Specific physical abilities required for this position include, but are not limited to: Ability to remain seated at a desk or workstation for extended periods. Ability to perform repetitive tasks like typing on a keyboard or using a mouse for extended periods. Ability to physically move around the office, organize or transport files, packages, or other office-related materials. Ability to read documents, use a computer, and perform data entry tasks. Ability to communicate clearly with management and coworkers, particularly in meetings or phone calls. Ability to operate standard office equipment such as computers, printers, phones, and copiers. Ability to occasionally lift and carry light objects, such as office supplies, documents, or small equipment. Nothing in this job description restricts Watts’ right to assign or reassign duties, responsibilities, and working hours/conditions to this position at any time. This position is “at will,” which means that either the employee or Watts may terminate the employment relationship at any time, with or without notice, and for any lawful reason. Watts in it for you : Please note that the following benefits apply only to permanent roles and do not apply to internship roles. Competitive compensation based on your skills, qualifications and experience Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits Family building benefits, including paid maternity/paternity leave 10 paid holidays and Paid Time Off Continued professional development opportunities and educational reimbursement Additional perks such as fitness reimbursements and employee discount programs Learn more about our benefit offerings here: https://tapintowattsbenefits.com/ How we work: At Watts, our culture is team-oriented and supportive. Employees here genuinely care about the quality of their work, and about each other. Our people are the heart of who we are and contribute to our longevity and continued success. And this is a place where you can have a big career. No matter your role, there are opportunities for learning and development, and your daily contributions make a meaningful impact on the lives of people who use our products and on the future of water. Watts is committed to equal employment opportunity. We follow a policy of administering all employment decisions and personnel actions without regard to race, color, religion, creed, sex, pregnancy, national origin, sexual orientation, age, physical or mental disability, genetic disposition or carrier status, marital status, military or veteran status, minorities, or any other category protected under applicable federal, state, or local law. Consistent with the obligations of state and federal law, Watts will make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. Any employee who needs a reasonable accommodation should contact Human Resources.

title: Digital Product Strategy & Delivery Director
jd_text: At TruStage, we’re on a mission to make a brighter financial future accessible to everyone. We put people first, and work hand in hand with employees and customers to create a diverse and inclusive environment. Passionate about building insurance and financial services solutions, we push the boundaries of what’s possible. We need you to help us shape what’s next. You’ll be encouraged to share your experiences, ideas and skills to help others take control of their financial future. Join a team that has received numerous awards for being a top place to work: TruStage awards and recognition Job Purpose: Leads the strategy, performance, and long-term direction of a portfolio of digital products and experiences. Guides Digital Product Owners in shaping product visions and roadmaps, participating directly in business strategy and performance discussions, and leading cross-functional product teams to deliver digital experiences that drive measurable business, customer, operational, and enterprise results. Leverages and strengthens a product-centric operating model that brings Product, Design, Technology, Analytics, and business partners together around shared outcomes. Uses this model to enable Digital Product Owners to lead with clear accountability, build effective cross-functional teams, and move work from strategy through delivery, measurement, and continuous improvement. Job Responsibilities: Portfolio Strategy & Outcomes Set the portfolio vision, strategy, measures, and long-term capability direction in line with enterprise and business priorities. Take responsibility for overall portfolio performance and ensure product strategies and roadmaps add up to the expected results. Turn enterprise goals, business opportunities, customer needs, operating challenges, compliance requirements, and platform needs into a coherent set of digital capabilities and experiences. Balance immediate outcomes with modernization, maintenance, stability, compliance, accessibility, technical health, and long-term sustainability. Recommend portfolio investments and resolve tradeoffs among cross-functional product teams when demand exceeds capacity. Business Engagement & Digital Direction Develop and direct Digital Product Owners to serve as active leaders in business strategy and planning, accountable for translating desired outcomes into the right product and experience direction. Guide business leaders in understanding how digital experiences, data, customer insight, and emerging capabilities can expand what the business is trying to achieve. Position Digital Product Owners as the primary point of engagement for capability and experience decisions within their cross-functional product teams. Portfolio Governance Organize each cross-functional product team around clear outcomes and provide the recurring capabilities it needs to carry work from opportunity through sustained performance. Give Digital Product Owners room to lead while maintaining clear escalation points, portfolio alignment, and accountability for results. Build effective cross-functional teams by assembling the skills and capacity needed from across the organization and establishing shared accountability for operating as a single, autonomous delivery team. Resolve dependencies and decisions across cross-functional product teams at the lowest practical level without sacrificing shared capabilities or long-term commitments to short-term priorities. Product Management & Talent Leadership Lead, coach, and develop Digital Product Owners and other managers and professional staff, building leadership depth and succession readiness across the portfolio. Develop Digital Product Owners who act as trusted business partners, lead across functions, make sound product decisions, and remain accountable for results and long-term value. Establish clear Product Owner accountability for product vision, strategy, roadmaps, priorities, sequencing, backlog decisions, and results across the full product lifecycle. Set consistent expectations for discovery, research, experimentation, analytics, prioritization, value realization, and ongoing product health without limiting Product Owner autonomy. Strengthen the Product Management competency and build needed organizational capabilities through shared practices, coaching, talent development, succession planning, and continuous improvement. Innovation & Future Capability Development Monitor emerging technologies, customer expectations, market shifts, and digital practices and identify where they create practical opportunities for the portfolio. Bring forward ideas that can improve results, raise business ambition, or create new value. Test and adopt new capabilities through the appropriate cross-functional product teams, with clear ownership from concept through measurement. Move successful ideas into durable product roadmaps and operating ownership. The above statement of duties is not intended to be all inclusive and other duties will be assigned from time to time. Job Requirements: Bachelor’s degree in related field, or equivalent combination of education and/or related professional work experience. 12+ years of progressive experience in digital strategy, product management, customer experience, marketing, servicing, analytics, technology-enabled transformation, or a related field. 7+ years of leadership experience, including developing leaders, leading cross-functional teams, and building organizational capabilities. A record of leading a portfolio of digital products or capabilities and delivering measurable business, customer, operational, strategic, or enterprise results. Experience making Product Owners and cross-functional product teams active participants in business strategy, planning, and performance management. Experience establishing product-centered operating models, cross-functional product teams, product roadmaps, decision rights, and lifecycle practices. Ability to lead through influence and align senior leaders across business, Product, Design, Marketing, Analytics, Architecture, Engineering, Creative, and other functions. Strong business and digital judgment, with the ability to shape strategy, challenge assumptions, prioritize investment, manage competing needs, and make decisions that advance enterprise objectives. Strong communication, relationship management, organizational leadership, and executive presentation skills. Preferred Experience in a financial services organization or heavily regulated industry. At this time, we're not considering applicants that need any type of immigration sponsorship (additional work authorization or permanent work authorization) now or in the future to work in the United States. This includes, but IS NOT LIMITED TO: F1-OPT, F1-CPT, H-1B, TN, L-1, J-1, etc. #LI-SW If you’re ready to help make a difference, apply today. A resume is required to apply. TruStage may process applicant information using an Artificial Intelligence (AI) tool. title: Director, MacOS Engineering
jd_text: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description Visa’s Corporate IT organization is on a multi-year transformation to modernize the digital workplace, elevate employee experience, and enable secure, scalable, and frictionless productivity across the enterprise. Client Engineering is a critical pillar of this strategy, responsible for delivering highly reliable, secure, and intuitive endpoint platforms that support Visa’s global workforce. We are seeking a dynamic, transformational leader to join our team as Director, Client Engineering – macOS. This role owns Visa’s global macOS platform strategy, engineering, and operations—defining the end-to-end platform vision; driving modern management practices; and ensuring a best-in-class employee and developer experience at scale. The Director operates at the intersection of engineering excellence, security and risk partnership, user experience, and operational rigor—setting standards, shaping investment decisions, and leading cross-functional execution across a complex, regulated global enterprise. Job Scope This role has global responsibility for macOS platform architecture, engineering, lifecycle management, and service delivery across Visa. You will partner closely with Information Security, Workplace Technology, Enterprise Architecture, and business stakeholders to ensure the macOS platform is secure, resilient, and optimized for modern work. This role aligns to Visa’s Director job architecture and carries accountability for strategy, people leadership, financial stewardship, and cross-functional delivery. Key Focus Areas: The ideal candidate should be passionate about: Exceptional employee and developer experience — delivering a secure, intuitive macOS platform that removes friction and improves productivity. Modern, scalable platform management — strengthening zero-touch provisioning, configuration baselines, compliance-by-design, and automation. Security and risk partnership — building a hardened, auditable, resilient platform aligned to enterprise security and regulatory expectations. Operational excellence — measurable reliability, incident/problem management discipline, and continuous improvement rooted in telemetry and customer feedback. Shift-left and self-service enablement — reducing recurring issues through standardization, automation, and clear knowledge and tooling. Engineering culture and talent — building and developing a high-performing global team with strong standards, accountability, and inclusive leadership. Vendor and financial stewardship — optimizing commercial strategy and total cost of ownership while increasing platform value. Key Responsibilities: Transformational Leadership: Inspire, motivate, and guide the macOS client engineering organization to deliver secure, reliable, and delightful outcomes at global scale. Define and communicate a clear multi-year macOS platform vision and roadmap; translate strategy into executable quarterly outcomes and measurable KPIs. Lead, coach, and develop a global team of macOS engineers and platform specialists; build talent pipelines, succession plans, and meaningful career paths. Establish a culture of accountability, engineering excellence, and continuous learning; encourage constructive debate and psychological safety while driving decisions to closure. Strategy & Platform Leadership: Own the end-to-end macOS platform strategy aligned to Digital Workplace and Security roadmaps. Develop and execute modernization plans covering device management, OS lifecycle, patching, software delivery, compliance, and automation. Drive adoption of modern Apple ecosystem capabilities (e.g., zero-touch provisioning, declarative management, secure identity, virtualization, and developer tooling) where they improve scale, reliability, and experience. Act like an owner: shape investment trade-offs, optimize total cost of ownership, and ensure resources are directed toward highest-impact outcomes. Engineering & Architecture: Serve as the senior technical authority for macOS platforms, tooling, and endpoint integrations. Establish engineering standards, configuration baselines, and architectural patterns for macOS at enterprise scale; ensure designs are simple, supportable, and secure-by-default. Lead design and implementation of endpoint management capabilities (e.g., MDM, EDR, identity, compliance, patching, software delivery), ensuring interoperability across the broader digital workplace ecosystem. Think big and challenge the status quo by identifying emerging approaches that improve reliability, reduce operational toil, and accelerate secure delivery. Operational Excellence: Own service health, reliability, and performance of the macOS environment. Define and track platform KPIs, SLAs/SLOs, and experience metrics; use telemetry to identify patterns, prioritize improvements, and eliminate repeat issues. Ensure strong operational processes for incident management, root cause analysis, change management, and continuous improvement; learn from mistakes and harden systems and processes. Drive standardization, documentation, and knowledge practices (SOPs, runbooks, KBs) that enable shift-left support and reduce time-to-restore. Security & Risk Partnership: Embed security, compliance, and resiliency into platform design and daily operations. Partner with Cybersecurity and Risk teams to ensure macOS platforms meet Visa’s security, compliance, and regulatory requirements. Lead implementation of security controls including device trust, endpoint protection, hardening, vulnerability remediation, and compliance attestation. Hold ourselves and each other accountable for secure operations and timely remediation; ensure risk is transparent and actively managed. Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Build trust-based partnerships that align platform capabilities with user and business needs. Listen and learn from internal customers (employees, developers, support teams) to understand pain points and prioritize platform investments that improve experience and productivity. Own vendor strategy and commercial oversight for Apple and endpoint management partners; manage performance, roadmaps, and commercial negotiations. Communicate effectively with senior leadership on platform strategy, health, risks, and investment decisions; decide quickly and move fast while balancing security and operational rigor. This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in office will be confirmed by your hiring manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications 10+ years of relevant work experience and a Bachelors degree, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience Preferred Qualifications 12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD 12+ years of progressive experience in endpoint / client platform engineering with deep focus on macOS. Demonstrated experience leading macOS platforms at enterprise scale (e.g., 10k+ devices). Strong knowledge of Apple enterprise ecosystem, macOS internals, device management, and security frameworks. Experience in software development, GenAI development and application a huge plus Proven ability to operate at both strategic and execution levels in a large, complex organization; strong written and verbal communication and stakeholder influence. Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience; advanced degree preferred. Experience in highly regulated, global enterprise environments. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers. title: Head of Sales, US Strategic Grocery Foods
jd_text: ABOUT UNILEVER With 3.4 billion people in over 190 countries using our products every day, Unilever is a business that makes a real impact on the world. Work on brands that are loved and improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us. We are driven by our purpose: to make sustainable living commonplace, and it is our belief that doing business the right way drives superior performance. At the heart of what we do is our people – we believe that when our people work with purpose, we will create a better business and a better world. JOB PURPOSE The Head of Sales, US Strategic Grocery, leads the development and delivery of Unilever Foods' customer growth strategy across a portfolio of the most strategically important grocery retailers in the United States. This leader is accountable for driving volume, share, profit, and customer partnership objectives across an approximately $800M Foods portfolio representing nearly 70% of the Foods business . The role leads a large, matrixed organization and is responsible for accelerating profitable growth, strengthening customer relationships, and shaping the long-term commercial strategy across multiple strategic grocery customers. WHAT WILL YOUR MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES BE As the US Foods leadership team accelerates growth and transformation, the Head of Strategic Grocery will: Lead Unilever Foods' strategic grocery business across key customers including Kroger, Albertsons, Ahold Delhaize and other major grocery retailers , representing approximately 70% of Foods volume. Develop and execute customer strategies that deliver sustainable, profitable growth through Joint Business Planning, strategic negotiations, and customer-specific growth initiatives. Partner closely with Marketing, Customer Strategy & Planning (CSP), Category Management, Shopper Insights, Supply Chain, Finance, and Revenue Growth Management teams to build and deliver winning customer plans. Establish a scalable operating model across multiple customers, balancing enterprise priorities with unique customer needs and opportunities. Drive portfolio growth through category leadership, omnichannel execution, promotional effectiveness, assortment strategy, and revenue growth management. Lead senior-level customer relationships and top-to-top engagement strategies, building strategic partnerships that create long-term mutual value. Manage customer P&L performance and investment decisions to optimize growth, profitability, and return on investment. Lead, develop, and inspire a high-performing organization while building future leadership capability across the team. Champion Unilever's purpose-driven growth agenda by delivering winning outcomes for customers, shoppers, consumers, and the business. You’re a born leader: Develop and deliver joint business planning activities with customers, constantly optimizing the P&L, creating value and finding truly sustainable mutual ground through active JBP management You’re a strategy guru: Develop and execute a scalable, multi-customer growth agenda across strategic grocery retailers. Create resource allocation, investment, and portfolio strategies that maximize profitable growth while establishing common commercial disciplines that can be deployed across diverse customers and market conditions. You’re a teacher: Dedicated people leader and bench developer, able to attract, motivate, develop and retain talent cross functionally through clarity, connectivity and celebration of success. You’re a master negotiator: A skilled negotiator that sets the example to successfully navigate and influence senior leadership at the customer independently, effectively getting to resolution. You’re a paradox navigator: Successfully balance enterprise priorities with customer-specific business needs while leading a complex, matrixed organization across multiple strategic customers. Build alignment across Sales, CSP, Marketing, Category Management, Supply Chain, Finance, and Revenue Growth Management to deliver winning outcomes. You’re a culture & change champion: Develop a winning team for current and future performance WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED Experience & Qualifications Bachelor's degree required; MBA preferred. Minimum 15 years of progressive CPG commercial leadership experience, including significant Strategic Grocery and/or large-scale customer leadership responsibility. Proven leadership of large, complex customer portfolios with direct accountability for sales, profit, trade investment, and customer P&L performance. Deep experience leading strategic partnerships with major grocery customers such as Kroger, Albertsons, Ahold Delhaize, Publix, Wakefern, Meijer, or comparable retailers. Demonstrated success developing and executing Joint Business Plans, pricing and promotion strategies, revenue growth management initiatives, and omnichannel growth plans. Strong enterprise and matrix leadership skills with a track record of influencing across Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Category Management, Shopper Insights, and Sales organizations. Proven ability to build and develop high-performing teams while leading through organizational change and business transformation. Strong financial acumen with deep understanding of customer P&L levers including pricing, promotion, assortment, distribution, omnichannel strategy, and investment allocation. Experience leading large organizations and developing leadership talent pipelines. Strong executive presence with demonstrated success influencing senior customer and enterprise stakeholders. Demonstrated experience managing technology products, cross-functional initiatives, vendors, system integrators, and competing priorities. Strong product management, analytical, financial, and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business needs into scalable technology solutions. Strong communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and influencing skills across business and technology teams. Data, Cybersecurity, and AI in Business Strategy (BMGT 250): An interdisciplinary introduction to data analysis, cybersecurity, and artificial intelligence (AI) in business operations and decision-making. The goal is to collect, process and analyze business data, identify cybersecurity threats; and explore AI fundamentals for business applications. Topics include data processing techniques, cybersecurity risk analysis, and practical AI tools. Operations Management (OPMG 300): A comprehensive study of the design and management of business operations, with an emphasis on building competitive advantage. Objectives include the optimization of both product and service operating processes. Topics include product development, process analysis, project management, quality management and the supply chain. Sustainability Management (OPMG 310): An introduction to the principles, strategies, and practical applications of sustainable business practices.¿ Going beyond traditional profit incentives, this course also integrates social responsibility, environmental stewardship, sustainable resource utilization and economic stability into organizational decision making. Topics include environmental, social, and economic impacts of business, emerging trends and innovation, sustainable business strategies that contribute to long-term profitability. Quality in the Value Chain (OPMG 320): A study of tools and methodologies for improving quality across the organizational value chain with a goal to identify, analyze and reduce inefficiencies while enhancing customer satisfaction. Apply quality management techniques across different stages of the value chain to improve overall customer satisfaction and performance. Topics include quality assessment, quality improvement initiatives and applying quality management techniques to improve the value chain. Supply Chain (OPMG 340): An applied study of procurement processes with an emphasis on utilizing project management techniques. title: Senior Analyst, Sales Operations
jd_text: Mylan Pharmaceuticals Inc. Viatris is a global healthcare company uniquely positioned to bridge the traditional divide between generics and brands, combining the best of both to more holistically address healthcare needs globally. With a mission to empower people worldwide to live healthier at every stage of life, we provide access at scale, currently supplying high-quality medicines to approximately 1 billion patients around the world annually and touching all of life's moments, from birth to the end of life, acute conditions to chronic diseases. We have been included on number of award lists that demonstrate the impact we are making. Every day, we rise to the challenge to make a difference and here’s how the Senior Analyst, Sales Operations role will make an impact: Key responsibilities for this role include: Creates reports and dashboards of sales force performance and call metrics to Sales and Marketing teams on a weekly/monthly/quarterly cadence. Responsible for development and implementation of sales force alignments, call plan targeting and segmentation, and other quarterly planning, for assigned field sales force(s). Manages large, relational data to clean, merge, manipulate, and aggregate data for use in reporting. Serves as the central point of contact for field and management support for data and ad-hoc analytic requests. Collaborates with other business partners such as Marketing, Managed Markets, and Finance to provide operational analytics on sales force effectiveness and activities. Assists with data validation, support, and training of web & mobile app sales force reports. Cross-trains within Incentive Compensation and CRM, as well as participates in interdepartmental training to ensure alignment with Corporate goals. Creates and maintains organized process and report documentation for assigned sales force(s), and continually works to improve internal processes. Builds, maintains and promotes positive and professional working relationships with associates and management. Completes special projects as deemed necessary by management. Perform other duties as assigned. The minimum qualifications for this role are: Minimum of a Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) and 1-4 years of experience. Bachelor of Science/Arts degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Business, or related business field preferred. Experience working in Sales Operations and or Pharmaceutical company preferred. Prior experience in Alteryx, PowerBI, Tableau, and/or SQL, and familiarity with syndicated subnational data sources (such as IQVIA XPO & DDD, IRI) and internal data sources (chargebacks, CRM activity) is preferred. However, a combination of experience and/or education will be taken into consideration. Must possess knowledge of data analytics, reporting, and strategic analysis. Understanding sales business models and pharmaceutical industry preferred. Must be able to collaborate across functions while managing multiple projects simultaneously with a high degree of urgency. Must possess strong communication and organizational skills along with the ability to strategically analyze data and prepare reports. High proficiency in Excel (formulas, pivots, VLookups) and working knowledge of all Microsoft Office programs is required. Ability to work with peers, managers or directors, and other departments to communicate known concepts. Ability to solve equations, apply mathematical concepts, and perform computations. Must have basic understanding of statistics. Ability to calculate standard performance metrics and create visualizations. Proficiency in speaking, comprehending, reading and writing English is required. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location. The salary range for this position is $55,000 - $105,000. title: Center Hatchery Operator HY01- 1st Shift
jd_text: Job Details: Hatchery Worker Labor HY01 The starting pay for this position is $17.55/hr. with a $1.00 shift increase for second/third shifts. If you are looking to make an impact in a meaningful way, join us at Tyson Foods where we feed the world like family! We create quality products in a safe environment for our team members. We offer advancement opportunities and steady work. This facility operates 4 days a week and is responsible for the incubation and hatching of chicks that support poultry production operations. The facility may also operate on weekends and holidays, as needed, to meet production requirements and ensure continuous animal care and hatchery operations. JOB SUMMARY: The Hatchery Worker Labor HY01 supports essential hatchery operations that contribute to the production of healthy, high-quality chicks. This position is responsible for assisting with daily production activities, monitoring product quality, handling materials, maintaining accurate records, and supporting operational efficiency throughout the facility. Team members are expected to work safely, follow established procedures, and use sound judgment to help meet production, quality, animal welfare, and biosecurity standards. Duties may vary based on business needs and operational priorities. Work Schedule: This position is scheduled to work for the following hours: Monday 4:00 a.m. – 2:30 p.m. Tuesday 4:00 a.m. – 2:30 p.m. Thursday 4:00 a.m. – 2:30 p.m. Friday 4:00 a.m. – 2:30 p.m. Shift times, hours, weekends, and holidays may fluctuate based on production needs. All holidays are expected if it falls on a scheduled work day. Responsibilities: Responsibilities may include, but are not limited to: Support daily hatchery operations to help achieve production, quality, and animal welfare goals. Prepare, organize, and maintain work areas, equipment, and materials for efficient operations. Perform production-related activities involving eggs, chicks, supplies, and hatchery materials. Monitor chick quality and report concerns or irregularities to leadership. Move products, materials, and supplies throughout the facility using approved equipment and safe work practices. (pallet jack) Accurately document production information and complete required records using paper or electronic systems. Assist with routine equipment operation, inspections, and reporting of maintenance needs. Maintain compliance with all company policies related to safety, quality assurance, sanitation, biosecurity, animal welfare, and GMPs. Keep work areas clean, organized, and ready for production activities. Work cooperatively with team members and leadership to meet operational objectives. Demonstrate flexibility in supporting changing production demands and departmental priorities. Perform other duties as assigned to support hatchery and facility operations. Physical Requirements: Must be willing and able to perform the following: Must be willing and able to work in a fast-paced environment. Must be willing and able to stand for extended periods up to 10 hours. Must be willing and able to lift up to 50 lbs as needed throughout the shift. Must be willing and able to work in hatchery conditions including hot, cold, wet, humid, dusty, tolerate odors, noisy environments and varying temperatures. Must be willing and able to bend, reach, push, pull, climb, twist, and perform repetitive motions as required by the position. Must be willing and able to work around moving machinery and production equipment. Must be willing and able to wear required personal protective equipment. Must be willing and able to work around poultry, feathers, dust, and other hatchery-related materials. Must follow all Tyson biosecurity policies and procedures, including any facility-specific requirements related to personal protective equipment, visitor restrictions, animal contact, sanitation, and movement between areas as required. External Education and Experience: Minimum: High school diploma or equivalent preferred but not required; ability to follow written and verbal instructions and work safely in a production environment. Preferred: Previous hatchery, poultry, manufacturing, agricultural, or production experience; experience operating equipment, pallet jacks, tablets, or electronic production systems. title: Lead AI Research Scientist II - Digital Safety Research Institute
jd_text: Job Description We have an exciting opportunity for a Lead AI Research Scientist II a t UL Research Institutes. This is a remote based opportunity. The Lead AI Research Scientist II directs advanced research across specialized areas including natural language processing (NLP); computer vision (CV), signal processing (SP), and AI reasoning. This role leads AI safety research including literature surveys, AI safety experimental design, AI/software engineering, data acquisition, data analysis, and documentation necessary to execute comprehensive experimental studies. The Lead AI Research Scientist II defines concepts and criteria to resolve major problems in current programs or approaches. Projects require substantial knowledge of state-of-the-art AI and software engineering principles and theories and use professional concepts and procedures to solve a wide range of research-based problems. UL Research Institutes: At UL Research Institutes (ULRI) , we expand the boundaries of safety science to create a more secure and sustainable world. For more than a century, we have studied the unintended consequences of innovation, designed solutions to mitigate risk and shared our findings with academia, scientists, manufacturers, and policymakers across industries. We identify critical safety and sustainability issues, asking the tough questions because we believe a safer world begins with knowledge. Build a safer, more secure, and sustainable future with us. Join us and work with our Digital Safety teams who conduct the research required to produce that knowledge and put into practice. Digital Safety Research Institute: The Digital Safety Research Institute (DSRI) addresses unresolved safety risks and emerging dangers in the world’s digital ecosystem. We aim to help protect people from unwanted access to personal devices and privacy, algorithm, and disinformation threats by working to create a new digital safety ecosystem. DSRI is committed to sharing digital safety insights, collaborating with key stakeholders, and offering extensive outreach and education to help support safer digital environments for people everywhere. What you’ll learn and achieve: As the Lead AI Research Scientist II, you will play a key role in the rapid growth of UL as you: Formulate, design, and manage independent test and evaluation research programs to protect the public from AI systems harms – focusing on testing systems enabling the most public harm. Lead and contribute to the development of competitive research proposals, including using the Heilmeier criteria to define scope, methodology, and deliverables, to secure funding for independent AI test and evaluation research programs. Serve as a principal investigator for Digital Safety’s’ independent test and evaluation research programs in their specialty area. Apply intensive and diverse knowledge of technology and AI/software engineering concepts to execute and manage specific research programs. Analyze experimental results to determine causes of problems and develop solutions, and evaluates technical specifications and factors related to process or design objectives. Plan, design, and complete initial and follow-up procedures as needed to validate the testing and evaluation results. Plan, design, and execute research challenges, using and improving DSRI’s evaluation tools, to lead their AI specialty community to solve problems of importance to transition partners. Propose and host workshops at leading research conferences in AI safety where research challenge winning methods and their comparative results are discussed to move the field forward in producing results that can have impact in public safety. Stay ahead of changing technologies in the field by reading papers and scientific publications and attending academic conferences. Contribute to and/or lead other department specific and cross-functional initiatives. What you’ll experience working at UL Research Institutes: We have pursued our mission of working for a safer, more secure, and sustainable world for nearly 130 years, embedding conscientious stewardship into everything we do. People : Our people make us special. You’ll work with a diverse team of experts respected for their independence and transparency and build a network, because our approach is collaborative. We collaborate across disciplines, organizations, and geographies to build the global scientific response that today’s global challenges require. Interesting work : Every day is different for us here. We see what’s on the horizon and use our expertise to build the foundations of a safer future. You’ll have the opportunity to push the boundaries of human understanding as part of a team working to advance the public good. Grow and achieve : We learn, work, and grow together through targeted development, reward, and recognition programs. Values . Four core values guide our work: collaboration, respect, integrity, and beneficence. By living our values, we inspire the trust essential to fulfilling our mission and foster the partnerships that enable us to pursue a beneficent future in which we all can thrive. Total Rewards : All employees at UL Research Institutes are eligible for bonus compensation. We offer comprehensive medical, dental, vision, and life insurance plans and a generous 401k matching structure of up to 5% of eligible pay. Moreover, we invest an additional 4% into your retirement saving fund after your first year of continuous employment. Depending on your role, you may be able to discuss flexible working arrangements with your manager. We also provide employees with paid time off, including vacation, holiday, sick, and volunteer days. What makes you a great fit: While no one candidate will embody every quality, the successful candidate will bring many of the following professional competencies and personal attributes: Demonstrated general knowledge of AI and software engineering disciplines. Demonstrated experience securing research funding through competitive proposal development. Demonstrated ability to write and win proposals for leading research workshops. Demonstrated ability to attract invitations to give keynote presentations. Excellent communication skills required. Advanced AI engineering, software engineering, and data analysis skills. Ability to collaborate effectively with research scientists, engineers, team members, and external partners to deliver research outcomes. Ability to publish research results at leading academic conferences. Professional education and experience requirements for the role include: PhD in Computer Science with a focus in the applicable AI area of specialty plus 8 or more years of directly related research experience. About UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement UL Research Institutes and UL Standards & Engagement are nonprofit organizations dedicated to advancing safety science research through the discovery and application of scientific knowledge. We conduct rigorous independent research and analyze safety data, convene experts worldwide to address risks, share knowledge through safety education and public outreach initiatives, and develop standards to guide safe commercialization of evolving technologies. title: People Solutions Analyst
jd_text: About Us Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid. At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you. Job Description The Global People Solutions Analyst supports Visa’s People Shared Services organization by managing end-to-end operations with accuracy, confidentiality, and care. This role partners closely with employees, managers, Payroll, Finance, Legal, Employee Relations, People Business Partners, and other People Team stakeholders to deliver consistent, compliant, and timely support. The Analyst will help ensure a seamless employee experience while contributing to operational excellence, process consistency, and continuous improvement. Essential Functions: Administer, monitor, and track cases from intake through closure, ensuring timely execution and alignment with applicable company policies and country-specific requirements. Prepare, review, and coordinate documentation, including employment related materials, calculation inputs, approvals, and employee communications. Partner with Payroll and Finance to support accurate payment processing, reconciliation, and resolution of payment-related questions. Serve as a knowledgeable point of contact for employees, managers, and People Team stakeholders on processes, timelines, policies, and procedures. Maintain accurate case records, documentation, and reporting while adhering to strict confidentiality standards for sensitive employee information. Collaborate with Legal, Employee Relations, People Business Partners, and other internal teams to support case management, documentation accuracy, and timely issue resolution. Conduct audits, peer reviews, and data validation to support accuracy of calculations, documentation, case status, and operational reporting. Identify process gaps, support root-cause analysis, and recommend improvements to strengthen quality, timeliness, consistency, and employee experience. Use HR systems and case management tools, including Workday and ServiceNow, to research employee information, document activity, update cases, and support operational workflows. &#xa;Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager. Qualifications Basic Qualifications 2 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD, or PhD) Preferred Qualifications 3 or more years of work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or more than 2 years of work experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) 3 or more years of relevant HR operations, People Shared Services, employee lifecycle, or systems operations experience. Experience in HR operations, People Shared Services, employee lifecycle administration, or a related operational support function. Demonstrated ability to manage confidential employee information with discretion, integrity, and sound judgment. Analytical capability to conduct audits, validate data, identify discrepancies, and support accurate case and payment processing. Strong attention to detail, organization, and follow-through in a deadline-driven environment. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain processes clearly to employees, managers, and cross-functional stakeholders. Information for US Applicants For roles located in the US, the estimated salary range for this position is $76,000.00 to $ 117,700.00 USD per year, which may include potential sales incentive payments (if applicable). Salary may vary depending on job-related factors which may include knowledge, skills, experience, and location. In addition, this position may be eligible for bonus and equity.Visa has a comprehensive benefits package for which this position may be eligible that includes Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), FSA/HSA, Life Insurance, Paid Time Off, and Wellness Program. Work Hours Varies upon the needs of the department. Travel Requirements This position requires travel 5-10% of the time. Mental/Physical Requirements This position will be performed in an office setting. The position will require the incumbent to sit and stand at a desk, communicate in person and by telephone, frequently operate standard office equipment, such as telephones and computers.
